tei:div.tei:p: 1. chos kyi dbang phyug

2. rigs byed ma/ 3. rgyal tshab grags pa mchog dbyangs/ 4. drung kun dga' rnam rgyal/ 5. karma chags med/ 6. 'ba' tsha/ 7. nye gnas/ zhwa dmar sku phreng drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi lo rgyus/ ༄༅/ /gar dbang drug pa dpal ldan chos kyi dbang phyug rdo rje dga' ba don kun yongs su grub pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba ni/ 'bri khung gzho'i lung pa spro lung zhes par/ yab 'bri gung chos rgyal phun tshogs dang*/ yum yong mo bza' g.yang 'gugs gnyis kyi sras su shing sprel hor zla dgu pa'i gnam gang gi tho rangs su dge ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs dgung lo lnga bzhes par grog snar/ rje dbang phyug rdo rjes ngos 'dzin mdzad/ gtsug phud dor/ dpal ldan gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gi mtshan dang*/ rgyal ba kun dngos dpal ldan bla ma mchog sogs kyi brtan bzhugs gnang*/ rje yab sras lhan rgyas bde chen yangs pa can du phebs/ zhwa dmar gyi cod pan gsol te seng ge'i khrir mnga' gsol bar mdzad/ mtshur phur phebs rgyal ba'i dbang po'i drung nas dbang lung 'ga' re zhus/ lhan rgyas gangs dkar du spyan drangs 'bul zhabs rgya cher phul/ yar stod dpon chen/ karma srong btsan tshangs pa yab sras/ sde pa 'phyang rgyas pa stobs rgyal mched rnams kyis spyan drangs/ dwags po bshad sgrub gling sogs nas gdan sa thel du phebs gser khrir mnga' gsol 'bri khung pad+ma gling du bcad rgya gnang skabs tshe dpag med zhal gzigs gnas bstod mdzad/ spro lung du stag lung dpon sa rin chen dpal mos brgya 'bul bshams dus me tog gi char babs/ 'bri khung thel gyi gnas mjal gnang*/ brag dkar lha chu'i gnas mjal mdzad de rims par phebs rtse lha sgang du rje dgu pa mjal dbang lung 'ga' re zhus/ lhan rgyas lta ba tshal khung du phebs/ sbrul lo gro bzhin can gyi tshes bcu gcig gi nyin thub bstan nyin byed gling gi 'dus sde btsugs/

lhan rgyas rgya la seng gtam du phebs slob dpon gyi zhabs rjes sogs mjal rgyal ba'i dbang pos phyag rjes dang rje nyid kyis zhabs rjes phebs/ rnam thos tshal du rje brgyad pa'i gsung 'bum lung zhus/ rje nyid dgung lo bcu gcig gi lor phrag sgrub sder phebs/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i drung nas bka' chos mang du zhus/ lhan rgyas nas tsā gong gi gnas mjal mdzad/ dga' ldan ma mor phebs tshes bcu'i 'chams dang smon lam sogs mdzad/ bshad sgrub gling du phebs/ sprul pa'i bye'u zhig dang dris lan mdzad do// rab brtan gling dang khra mo brag brgyud sku rab tu phebs/ yongs 'dzin rnam rgyal grags par chos 'brel zhus/ dwags lha sgam por phebs/ 'ja' sprin 'khrigs/ sku 'dra mthong ba don ldan gyis dbu zhwa phud pa dang khri nas 'phag pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung*/ yar stod g.yam bzang du phebs dpal lha mo'i sku 'bag la bka' bsgo sogs mdzad/ dga' tshal gzhung lugs gling pa sogs kyis chos kyi gleng slong zhus pas mkhas pa kun gyis gus pas zhabs la gtugs/ sprel lo dbo zla'i nyer bdun la khams nas si tu sprul pa'i sku chos kyi rgyal mtshan phebs pas mjal/ 'bul chen phul bar bka' chos sogs gnang*/ skyes mchog gtsug lag rgya mtsho dpon slob rnams kyis chibs bsu bcas sras mkhar du phebs/ gro bo lung sogs zhabs kyis bcag /gnya' gnya' phug tu sku mtshams mdzad/ rgyal ba'i dbang po dbang phyug rdo rje zhal gzigs/ gsung 'gur sogs mdzad/ gtsang sde srid kyis spyan drangs te/ lha lung*/ sna dkar rtse/ ra lung*/ dpal 'khor chos sde rnams su rims par phebs par 'bel gtam dang bka' chos kyis kun ngo mtshar ba gnang*/ nyin gling 'dus pa'i dbus su tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi ljags bshad mdzad/ kong po'i ja pas brgya 'bul phul dbu zhwa bzhes par 'ja' tshon gyi bla re bres/ khyung rtser phebs der yang rig lung mang po gnang*/

zhwa lu snar thang sogs brgyud bsam 'grub rtser phebs/ sde pas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ sog po'i gnas mjal dang*/ stag rna dang*/ thob rgyal du phebs chos ra rig lung bka' chos sogs rgya cher gnang*/ lha phu rdzong sar du tshad mdo dang 'dul ba dang mngon pa la ljags bshad mdzad/ zab phu'i gnas gzigs pas 'ja' tshon 'khrigs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang po shar gser mdog can dang*/ pa nam du phebs mngon rtog rgyan gyi ljags bshad gnang*/ gzhung mang po thugs la 'dzin pa tshogs rgyugs sprad de/ ji skad du/ nyam chung bdag gis bzung ba'i rim pa la// dbu ma rtsa she'i 'grel pa tshig gsal dang*// dbu ma 'jug pa rang 'grel dang bcas pa// rgya rol nyi snang 'grel pa don gsal dang*// rgyud bla mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa rnams// shes phyin phyogs kyi bzung ba'i rim pa'o// 'dul ba rgya cher 'grel dang rang 'grel dang*// 'od ldan dang ni 'dul ba'i lung rnams te// 'di rnams 'dul ba'i phyogs kyi gzung ba'i rim// mdzod kyi rang 'grel gzhon nu rnam rol dang*// kun btus phung lnga'i rab byed mngon pa'o// yan lag bstan bcos bzhi dang rigs thig 'grel// rang 'grel rigs gzhung rgya mtsho tshad ma'i skor// gso rig phyogs la rags pa'i rim pa dang*// sgra yi rig pa cha bsags mdo dang ni// bzo rig bstan bcos nyi ma'i me long dang*// nang don rang 'grel 'grel pa don gsal dang*// 'grel chen dri med 'od dang spyod bsdus te// de ltar sde tshan sum cu rtsa gcig rnams// da lta lce la blangs shing gsal bar bdog/ da ni phal cher song ba'i rim pa brjod// slob dpon dul ba lha yis mdzad pa yi// rigs thig 'grel dang rnam nges 'grel pa dang*// sa paṇa gyis mdzad rigs gter rang 'grel dang*// shāka mchog gis mdzad sde bdun ngag mtsho dang*// dar ma rin chen gyis mdzad tshad ma'i 'grel// de rnams phal cher song ba tshad ma'i skor//

sdom gsum 'grel pa dga' gdong gyis mdzad sogs// bltas pa'i rabs la brjod kyis mi langs so// zhes pa rang lo bcu drug gi thog tu bris pa'o zhes 'byung*/ dpal 'khor chos sde nas rgyang 'dur dang*/ bya gshong*/ thub bstan/ bkra shis lhun po/ gser mdog can/ grwa tshang chen mo/ gsung rab gling pa 'bras yul skyed tshal rnams kyi dge bshes mkhas pa rnams bsdus pa'i dbus su rje nyid kyis thog mar 'dul ba la dam bca' 'jogs par mdzad nas nyin zhag 'ga' zhig la rigs lung kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab/ de thams cad kyis thun mong min pa'i dad pa thob/ 'di pas lta ba rje brgyad pas bzhed pa'i thal 'gyur bzhed na'ang thal rgyang tsam ni mi bzhed do// sman ri'i bon po bcu gsum tsam rtsod par byung ba la gzhan gyis lan byed ma shes par de dang bstun pa'i lung rigs kyis dad par byas pas zhabs spyi bor blangs/ mi bskyod zhabs zhal gzigs pas/ nyam chung dga' ba'i ban chung chos dbang nga*// zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad 'ga' zhig gsungs/ phyi nang gi dbye ba sogs bstan bcos 'ga' re mdzad/ dgung lo bcu drug der sku na phra bas drung skor rnams kyis bshol kyang ma gsan par byang ngam ring du gra skor la phebs/ mang 'gyed rgyas par zhus/ rnam 'grel dang*/ mngon rgyan/ mngon pa gong ma/ 'dul ba/ rigs gter/ sdom gsum/ rtsa shes/ 'jug pa/ rgyud bla/ mdo sde rgyan/ mngon pa mdzod/ spyod 'jug dus 'khor sogs la nyi ma gnyis gsum re ljags bshad gnang*/ tshad ma kun btus la bshad pa'i 'phro 'jogs par mdzad/ gnas der 'jam dpal dbyangs ma pham mgon po'i rnam pa can zhal gzigs pas/ mkhyen rab thugs rje sogs bstod pa mdzad/ yang phyi nyin 'jam dbyangs de nyid shākya thub pa'i rnam pa can du zhal gzigs pas/ nges legs rin chen gling du 'khrid pa yi sogs bstod pa mdzad/ de'i phyi nyin 'jam dbyangs de nyid sgrol ma'i rnam par snang ba la/

'phags pa kun gyis rab tu bsngags byas kyang sogs bstod pa mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs de nyid dbyangs can ma'i rnam par mjal ba la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs sogs bstod pa mdzad/ yang 'jam dbyangs de nyid spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par gzigs pa la/ gzhan gyi don phyir byang chub sems bskyed nas sogs bstod pa mdzad/ yang 'jam dpal la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba zhal gzigs pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i gter sogs kyi bstod pa mdzad/ yang 'jam dpal de nyid sangs rgyas sman pha'i rgyal por snang ba la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes sku dang ni zhes sogs bstod pa mdzad/ rang gi phreng ba mtha' dag 'jam dpal du snang ba la/ snyan pa phyogs bcur khyab pa'i rnga sgra la/ /zhes sogs bstod pa mdzad/ yang 'jam dpal ku ru kul+le'i rnam par gzigs pa la/ /'jig rten kun gyi dpal dang grags pa dang*/ /zhes sogs bstod pa mdzad/ yang 'jam dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par mjal ba la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bde stong ye shes tog /zhes sogs bstod pa mdzad/ yang 'jam dpal nyid khro rgyal rta mgrin du snang ba la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mthu nus kun/ / zhes sogs bstod pa mdzad/ ngam ring gi dge 'dun thams cad 'jam dpal du snang ba la/ 'jam dbyangs rol pa 'gags med shar ba las/ /zhes sogs bstod pa mdzad pa'i tshe*/ de rnams kyis rim pa ltar phyag g.yas pa brkyang te/ khyod rang gi kun spyod rjes su sgrogs pa'i gtam du bgyis shig /de bzhin du yon tan rjes su sgrogs pa'i sogs bka' stsal par gyur to/ /de dag nyi ma re re bzhin du phyi ma phyi ma la'o// de nas lcags byi gnam lo gsar tshes kyi tshes gnyis la 'phags pa rin po che sku 'khrungs sar phebs sa 'og nas rje btsun ma'i li sku zhig thon pa sogs ngo mtshar ba du ma byung*/

ngam ring rdzong du phebs sde srid byang pas 'bul zhabs rgya cher bstabs/ myu gu lung sogs kyi gnas mjal mdzad/ mdo sde spyi rnam brtsam pa'i dbu tshugs/ sa skyar phebs/ sa skya paṇ+ḍita sku mdog dmar gsal zhig zhal gzigs/ gang la khyod kyi dag pa de/ /sogs bstod pa mdzad/ phag gru phug tu pheb dus sa chen gyi gtsug tu 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ snyan gong g.yas su sa paṇa/ g.yon du phag gru/ pus mo g.yas su rnam snang*/ g.yon du rje btsun grags pas mtshan pa zhig gis/ ma 'ongs mkhar gyi ming can du/ khyod kyi gtsug lag dar bar go zhes sogs dang*/ nyer brgyad nyin/ khyod kyi dag pa'i dag pa la/ zhes sogs dang*/ yang*/ ri la yi thog ma ldan pa las zhes sogs lung bstan mang po gnang*/ der mdo sngags rig gnas sogs ma bslabs pa mang po yang rdol shes su gyur to/ /lhun po rtser phebs mang po zhig la dge 'dun 'du chog gi dbang mdzad/ cho ga'ang gsar bsgrigs gnang snar thang du bka' chen bzhi dbu ma dang lnga yi thal phreng thugs brtsam mdzad/ snyan ngag dang sdeb sbyor gyi bshad pa gsan/ sde pa snar thang pas zhabs pad spyi bor blangs/ bsam 'grub rtser phebs/ sde par bka' chos 'ga' re gnang*/ 'dus sder dgongs gcig gi ljags bshad gnang*/ bkra shis lhun po'i tshogs dbur phebs/ grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i lta ba'i gnas tshul sogs bshad pas de thams cad zol med pa'i dad pa thob bo/ /jo mo gangs kyi gnas mjal gnang nas/ yangs pa can du phebs/ tshogs su phyag chen lnga ldan gyi khrid gnang*/ gtsang sde srid dang sog po'i bar chings mdzad/ gnam mchor phebs dus thang lhas mchod rdzas du mas mchod pa dang gnam mtsho'i gtsug gi nor bu phul ba sogs ngo mtshar ba du ma byung*/ thang lhar dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phog /yangs can 'dus sder dus 'khor dang dge 'dun 'du chog gi dbang bskur/ lha sar phebs rdo ring la/ lha dang lha yi bla ma ni/

/zhes sogs kyi phyag ris gnang*/ yangs can du sku rim chen mo btsugs/ 'chams yig thugs brtsam gnang*/ dgung lo bco brgyad la smon mkhar du 'bri khung zhabs drung dang mjal phrad gnang*/ yer pa/ rgyal rtse sogs nas/ mtshur phu brgyud/ smug po tshal du phebs/ rje dgu pa dang*/ rgyal tshab rin po che dang*/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho rnams mjal/ dbang phyug rdo rje'i drung nas lnga tshan lnga'i bde mchog dbang dang phyag bzhi pa'i dbang rgyas par gnang*/ karma pak+shi'i bka' 'bum dang*/ 'bri gung zab chos/ rol pa'i rdo rje dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po bka' 'bum sogs kyi lung zhu bar mdzad/ dgung lo bcu dgu'i zla ba dang por/ rten gan+dho la'i drung du rje dgu pas mkhan po dang*/ gnas kyi slob dpon rgyal tshab/ gsang ston rje gtsug lag rgya mtshos mdzad de grangs tshang ba'i dge 'dun gyi dbus su dpal ldan gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug rdo rje dga' ba don kun yongs su grub pa phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba zhes pa'i mtshan dang bcas bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ de nas rgyal ba'i dbang po'i drung nas rngog dkyil bdun dang sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang gnang*/ pa nam du phebs/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i drung nas rgyud 'bum gyi lung dang mkha' spyod bka' 'bum gyi lung gnang*/ rje nyid nas yangs can pa sogs la dus 'khor gyi dbang gnang*/ rje yab sras gnyis kyi 'khrungs rabs rnam thar brtsam/ sdom pa thag drwa ma'i shes byed kyi brtsam pa mdzad/ rgyal tshab rin po che nas 'phags pa bskal bzang sogs mdo mang gi lung bstsal/ lhan rgyas sogs don gyis spyan drangs yul der phebs nas dge ba la bkod/ tha ba khar rje nyid sku mtshams su bzhugs par sangs rgyas mnyan pa zhal gzigs nas zhal gdams gnang bas/ nga mdangs sum nyams kyi snang ba la/ zhes sogs mgur mdzad/ rje dgu pa'i dgung lo'i tshad bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis yin kyang rje 'dis gsol ba btab pas dgung lo brgyad du sku tshe byin gyis brlabs pa'i zhe brgyad pa/

stag lo zla ba dang po'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin shang rnam gling du rje karma pa dbang phyug rdo rje dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa rgyal tshab dang dpa' bo rin po che bcas kyis sku gdung rin po mtshur phur gdan drangs pa dang*/ rje nyid mtshur phur phebs sku gdung 'od bzhu dang mchod 'bul rgya cher bsgrubs/ gnam rtse lding du phebs dam can la gsol mchod bka' bsgo gnang*/ mtshur phur rgyal tshab rin po che'i drung nas rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang rnams dang*/ 'jigs byed lha dgu/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ bde mchog dkar po/ bde mchog mi tra bcu gsum/ gdugs dkar zhe gnyis ma/ dam tshig gsum bkod/ rnam snang mngon byang*/ 'jam dbyangs dmar po/ bde mchog lus dkyil/ rta nag /rta dmar/ bder 'dus/ 'khor lnga/ tshe ring ma rnams kyi dbang zhus/ rje nyid 'dus sde rnams kyis rgyal ba'i dbang po'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol bsam gtan gling pas brgya 'bul dang dbu zhwa bsgron/ rgyal tshab rin po che nas bka' 'gyur gyi lung 'phro gsan pa'i dbu tshugs/ rgyal ba'i dbang po sku gshegs pa'i phyi nyin nyi shu dgur 'ja' sprin gyi dbus su zhwa nag gser mdangs 'dzin pa'i dge slong du mdzad de gnyug ma'i gnas lugs ngo sprod dang*/ ma 'ongs sprul pa'i sku 'byung ba'i gnas dang zhing sogs lung bstan gnang nas sgyu ma bde mchog gi skur bzhengs dbang bskur dkyil 'khor nyis brgya rtsa gsum gyi skal pa can du mdzad/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams rigs lnga'i tshul du zhu ba'i kha sbyor gyi byang sems kun+da lta bu byin/ spros med spros pa'i rnal 'byor pa de/ sogs zhal gdams gnang nas/ bla ma drin can chos rje sogs gsol ba btab/ lha sa/ gsang phu/ snye thang sogs su phebs/ jo bo'i snyan dar zhal yig du/ bzhag ti brag gsum gyi grong khyer na sogs ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi gsol 'debs gnang ba la gong sa lnga pas de zhwa dmar bas gyod tshig gnang ba red ces gsungs 'dug pa de'o/

/gnam mtsho dor phebs dgongs kyang dar ma chags pas pheb ma grub par/ ba nyis stong bzhos pa'i zho dang gcig sogs bka' shog gnang bas mtsho la dar chags nas der phebs/ zhag gcig bzhugs pa nam du phebs/ rje dgu pa'i rnam thar thugs brtsam dang*/ 'dul ṭīk brtsam dbu tshugs/

shing 'brug gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ston dang cog grar chos drug gnang*/ nyer brgyad la rje dgu pa'i sku mchod phul/ yol mo sku skye'i gtsug phud breg dge bsnyen byas/ zal mo brag tu phebs/ bsam 'grub rtser sde pa sku mched rnams la 'dod chos phul/ 'di rnams kyi gseng du rgyal tshab dam pa nas bka' 'gyur gyi lung zhus/ sa tham rgyal po'i 'bul skyel ba rnams 'byor/ mtha'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi rug ma zer ba nas a tsa ra gcig gis rin po che'i rigs mang po zhig phul/ jo nang kun dga' snying po dpon slob rnams kyis mjal/ phag mo'i dbang dang gnang sbyin byas/ gter ston mchog ldan mgon pos mjal/ a tsa ra bzhis sman mang po phul/ 'or shod pas 'bri gung du dmag bteg pa'i bar chings pa gnang*/ sbrul lo'i dbo zla nas bka' 'gyur lung grub/ 'og min gling gi 'dus sde rnams la pusti lnga'i ljags bshad gnang*/ zam brag rdo rje'i spo ru nyin gling gtsug lag khang gi rmang bting*/ g.yung nas bteg /rin spungs su phebs/ zhabs drung la rdo rje shugs kyi rjes gnang mdzad/ de nas yangs pa can dang mtshur phur phebs/ rje dgu pa'i dngul gdung la rab gnas mdzad pas me tog shar pa sogs ngo mtshar ba byung*/ rgyal tshab drung nas mi tra brgya rtsa dang khrid drug dang*/ zhang gi bka' 'bum lung gsan/ gnas nang*/ bde chen/ pa ra rnams su phebs shun mi dbang gis mchod cing za dam rgyal po rir phebs nyer gsum la gtsug lag khang gi rmang bting nas zhal bkod gnang*/ bde chen du phebs sde srid gtsang pa'i rje mo'i rjes sgrub mdzad/ sog rgyal kha dan gyis gdan nas gnam mtsho'i nye log du rgyal po kha dan chibs bsur 'byor/ 'brang zhal ne'u sing du kha dan la tshe dbang brgya rtsa mdzad rta brgya nor brgya lug stong tshwa rgyab lnga brgya phul de phyogs su sdig spangs dge bsgrub rgya cher mdzad/ bkra shis do bo'i gnas mjal mdzad/

thang lhar bka' bgo gnang*/ 'ba' bram dang dbu ma'i gnas mjal nas yangs can du/ yangs can zur cog sogs la phyag chen lung sbyor dang chos drug gi lung gnang*/ na mgo bkra shis sgang dang rdza dkar legs gling*/ gangs dkar chos sde'i rten mjal dang srin po rir gnas gzigs mdzad/ mtshur phur phebs/ rgyal tshab drung nas 'dul ba'i lag len phra zhib rnams dang snyan brgyud rdo rje zam pa'i skor rnams zhus/ bde chen dang*/ za dam du phebs nyin gling par chos ra'i 'dzin chos gnang*/ tshad ma'i spyi don thugs brtsam mdzad/ mal gro gangs dkar du phebs/ chos rje zhal ngo rnams dang bzhugs gral gnang*/ gnas gzigs mdzad/ chos rje sogs la lnga ldan khrid dang tshes bcu'i gtor dbang gnang*/ dus rim gtor 'phen sogs dang lug lo'i lo sar mdzad/ smon lam tshugs/ phag mo zhabs drung sogs la bde mchog sogs lnga tshan lnga'i dbang gnang lo dgon la phebs li ma lha khang sogs mjal/ phag mo rtser phebs/ pu to ba sku mched kyi phug pa sogs mjal/ gangs dkar nas rdzong sar dang 'bri gung mthil du phebs/ sa khri dmar por bzhugs nas phyag chen khrid mdzad/ 'jong khra dbon por sgra 'tshams sbyor gyi ri mo bslab/ bkra shis phun tshogs grags pa rnam rgyal sku mched la/ sme brtsegs/ rnam 'joms/ rta mgrin/ ber nag can rnams kyi rjes gnang mdzad/ chos rje sku 'bring bar dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal zhes pa'i mtshan dang rab byung gi bslab pa bstsal/ zur mang sku skye karma blo gros phrin las rgya mtshos brgya 'bul sogs phul/ zhwa lha khang mjal/ zur cog gi ser sbreng bcas gangs dkar du phebs/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs sar phebs smon lam mdzad/ rgya ma khri gang du bzhugs/ g.ya' ma lung mjal/ bsam yas su phebs/ has po ri'i rtser ska cog zhang gsum gyi 'bum pa mjal/ dbu rtse sogs gnas mjal zhib par gnang*/ pe har la go mtshon sogs byin nas bka' bsgo mdzad/

mkhan po'i sku 'bum dang bu tshab gser khang gi zhig gso 'ga' re gnang*/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i sogs gsung mgur mdzad/ mchims phur phebs zhag bdun sku mtshams la bzhugs/ rje skyabs gnas rnams la sogs gsung mgur mdzad/ gur dkar phug tu tshogs 'khor mdzad pa'i skabs/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i gzigs snang la/ rje nyid dang slob dpon chen po lhan rgyas pa'i drung du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang pos tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor nas chos nyan pa'i snang ba byung zhing*/ de phyin chad nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma dang dbyer med pa'i dag snang thun mong ma yin pa 'khrungs zhes rnam thar du 'dug /dbu rtser yang ri dang nyin gling gi tshogs dbur phebs nas smon lam chen mo gnang*/ sngags grar phebs/ yar rgyab pas gzhi len zhus/ 'dus pa rnams la ber gyi dbang sogs gnang*/ yang rdzong shel phug gi gnas mjal mdzad/ spang shang lha ri kha dang ngar phug sogs mjal/ 'gos lo'i sku 'bum dang 'bo stag tshang sogs mjal/ chos rje dkon mchog sogs la ngal gso skor gsum gyi 'dzin chos gnang*/ thel du phebs/ 'phan chen zhal phyes grwa tshang la dge tshul gyi bslab pa byin/ ras bris la brten pa'i bsnyen kha gsos nas rdul tshon la brten pa'i rdor phreng nyer brgyad kyi dbang bla med kho na ltar bskur bar mdzad/ gdan sa'i rten gsum zhig gso dang pher gyi rjes gnang sogs dbang lung 'ga' re dang gsung brtsam mang po mdzad/ byang bdag po sogs la phyag chen khrid gnang*/ phag mo gru'i gnas mjal dang*/ de nas rim par zul phur phebs/ bya rgod dbu can la bka' bsgo mdzad/ gangs ri thod dkar gangs dkar du phebs/ sde pas gzhi len dang gangs dkar ba'i dus rim 'chams gzigs phul/ sprel lo'i lo gsar dang smon lam chen mo mdzad/ dol klu sdings su phebs tshong dus rgyal por sems bskyed gnang bka' bsgo mdzad/ mchim phu ba sogs la rab byung dang kha rag grwa tshang la phyag chen khrid gnang*/

bye rdzing du phebs rten mjal mdzad/ byams pa gling dang gra thang gi gnas mjal/ rnam sras gling dang*/ do sngon brgyud/ mi dbang dpon blon gyi chibs bsu bcas/ sne gdong rtser gdan drangs ltar phebs/ khra 'brug dang shel brag tu tshogs 'khor gnang*/ na mo gu ru re ltos dran mchog gi chos rje sogs gsung mgur mdzad/ ras chung phug tu phebs yig drug sgom lung sogs gnang*/ blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid byas chos rgyal pho brang du phebs mkha' reg sprul sku'i gtsug phud blangs/ yar stod du sde pas spyan drangs khrom sar phebs/ sa skyong karma tshe 'phel gyi yar 'dren mdzad/ dga' tshal dang dpal mo bkod pa'i grwa tshang rnams rab byung byas/ 'phyong rgyas dang thang po che sogs dang*/ rnam rgyal la phebs/ sde pa pho brang ba sogs la snyan dngag gi bshad pa gnang*/ 'jigs mdzad dbang chog mdzad/ dga' tshal ba sogs la 'dul ba'i ljags bshad gnang*/ sku rab bkra shis sgang du chos rje tre chen dang spom dgon bla mas mjal/ zho kha ba dang o rong ba'i 'khrug pa bsdum/ dgyer stod chos 'khor gling du phebs lha chen la nang bzhugs dang rab gnas mdzad/ sgam por phebs khams pa mi gsum gyi zhabs rjes sar byon skabs 'ja' 'od shar/ sgam po sprul sku karma mi pham phrin las rnam rgyal bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ gnas skor dang gnas gzigs mdzad/ der 'khod rnams la mdo rtsa'i lung sogs lugs gnyis kyis re ba thams cad gang bar mdzad/ de nas yam dgon rdza gseb brgyud bshad sgrub gling du phebs 'chams gzigs phul/ grwa pa rnams la dge tshul slong gi bslab pa byin/ bca' khrims bsdams/ rab brtan gling pa dang sgo gsang sngags gling par phyag chen gyi khrid sogs gnang*/ dang lung khra mo brag gi gnas gzigs gnang*/ bkra shis sgang nas tsā rir phebs/ skyer zhol mo cher phebs dus skyo shas kyi mgur mdzad/ pad+ma shel phug tu zhal gzigs mang po byung*/

rigs lnga rdzong chen mjal dus sngon te lo'i drung du bzhugs pa sogs sngon gnas 'ga' re dran gsungs 'dug /rgyal ba sras bcas kun dang sogs chos bro gnang*/ mtsho dkar du phebs/ khyung rdzong du dgun bzhugs gnang ba'i sta gon mdzad/ in+d+rabhū ti'i phug sogs mjal/ zhu bde phug nas tsan dan mang du bsnams nas phebs/ sde pa sku rab pas dgun bzhugs kyi gsol chas phul nas khyung rdzong du bsam gtan la bzhugs/ skabs zhig mnal lam du da dung rnam rgyal khang bzang gi nye logs su rje rol pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs rjes yod pa ma mjal zer ba ltar rnam rgyal khang bzang gi gam nas zhabs rjes de gsal bar rnyed nas lha khang du bzhugs pa 'di'o/ /rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi ljags bsnyen mdzad/ dpag bsam 'khri shing gi me tog gi thugs brtsam mdzad/ phyag chen dang thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid gnang*/ yang sgrol ma'i bsnyen pa gnang*/ bstod pa'ang mdzad/ zhing skyong gi sgrub pa'ang mdzad/ mtsho dkar sgrub sder mos gus chen mo'i khrid sogs gnang*/ bya lo'i lo gsar dang smon lam sogs mdzad/ si tu sprul sku dang khams ri bo che'i sprul sku sogs kyi 'bul skyel mi sna 'byor/ sa tham rgyal po'i bka' 'gyur par bzhengs pa'i phyi mo tshal pa bka' 'gyur zhu dag bcas g.yar dgos tshul gyi yi ge sleb par lan brdzangs/ nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'khri shing me tog gi lung gnang*/ rje dpa' bo'i drung du karma pa chos dbyings rdo rje spyan 'dren gyi zhu yig dang*/ sras mkhar sku 'drar de don gyi snyan shal zhu yig yang phul bas mdo khams phyogs su pheb dgos pa'i lung bstan byung*/ chos drug bdud rtsi'i nying khu thugs brtsam gnang*/ der bzhugs rgyu'i rje dbang phyug rdo rje'i sku 'dra phyag bzo gnang mtsho dkar 'du khang du zhing skyong gi rten gtor bzhengs nas rten 'dzugs mdzad/ mtsho dkar ba rnams la phag mo'i dbang dang chos drug gi khrid btsugs/

'jang rgyal po'i gdan 'dren pa rnams sleb/ nyid dang rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku brnyan dang skyobs pa'i sku gsar bzhengs rnams la nang bzhugs phul nas dus 'khor gyi rnal 'byor ma rigs so drug gi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab gnas mdzad/ bya khyung bla ma dang mtsho dkar ba sogs la rta mgrin dang phag mo dang tshe ring mched lnga'i dbang gnang*/ 'dan ma phug tu tshogs 'khor dang gsung mgur mdzad/ mchod rten bkra shis 'od 'bar la zhabs skor gnang*/ sgrub pa ba rnams rang rang gi 'dod don rnams grub par mdzad/ gnas khyad du 'phags pa'i tsā ri tra sogs gsung mgur mdzad/ la khar chos bro bcas zhing skyong sku mkhar du phebs zhing skyong la bstod pa mdzad/ gcig car lwa ba phug lha mo sgang du phebs/ yul smad du dpal mo bkod pa'i grwa tshang la phyag chen lnga ldan gnang*/ sku rab tu phebs/ de nas rim par mal gro gangs dkar dang thang sag tu phebs dbu ma'i spyi don mdzad/ 'jang du bka' 'gyur gyi par dpe sogs bskur/ za dam dang yer pa dang lha sa rnams su phebs/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan khang sar du zhag gnyis bzhugs/ za dam du phebs/ 'jang rgyal po'i gdan 'dren pa rnams sleb 'du khang gi ldebs bris kyi bkod yig thugs brtsam gnang*/ mtshur phur phebs sgar pa sogs la rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje 'go log tu sku 'khrungs yod pas spyan 'dren dgos tshul bka' gnang*/ mdo khams su phebs pa'i thugs thag bcad nas/ gtsang sde pa phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis spyan drangs nas rnam gling du phebs sde pa dpon blon rnams kyi thugs 'dod gang bar mdzad/ 'o yug gos sngon du phebs phur pa'i lha tshogs zhal gzigs/ nga mdangs gsum nyal ba'i rmi lam la sogs mgur mdzad/ dam can la snyan dar bka' bsgo sogs gnang*/ gangs ra lo chen yang chibs skyel du pheb byung*/ yar rgyab pas spyan drang nas lha sa po ṭa lar phebs/ gnas ra sa 'phrul snang bya ba der zhes sogs mdzad/

mtshal gung thang du phebs gnas mjal mdzad/ dga' ldan khang sar du phebs zhag bzhugs gnang*/ de nas yangs can nas khams su phebs pa'i sgar gra bsgrigs bka' bkod sbyar nas bkra shis mthong smon du bzhugs/ hor stod pa'i nang 'khrug bsdums/ ra sgreng spa khug du 'bri khung chos rje phebs pas mjal/ spa kaṃ sul du zhag bdun sku mtshams mdzad/ nam ra rgyang mjal dang bsam pa lhun grub ma zhal 'don mdzad/ tsan dan dgon du phebs 'brang bu gu shri sogs kyis mjal/ dgyes rdor dbang byas/ skabs 'di rnams su zang zing gi dngos po char 'bab pa ltar ni brir ma langs/ de nas rim par byang rta rna dgon du phebs/ ri bo che nas sku skye karma grags pa rnam rgyal dpon slob rnams phebs/ bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen dang bcas ri bo cher phebs/ rten mchod rnams zhib par mjal/ 'du khang du bla grar tshogs chos mu tig phreng ba gnang*/ kar zur gnyis kyi zlos gzhi bsdum pa'i mi sna brdzangs/ sprul sku sogs la dgyes rdor gyi dbang bskur/ chos rje khri thog par karma grags pa rgyal mtshan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba zhes pa'i mtshan dang dge tshul slong gi bslab pa phog/ gzhan yang bsnyen rdzogs brgya phrag tsam bsgrubs/ chos rje sogs la kun rig dang phyag bzhi ba sogs kyi dbang sogs phul/ ston pa'i tshems sogs nang rten rnams mjal/ mchog gi sprul sku chos dbyings rdo rje'i drung du zhu yig bcas yang ri ba brdzangs/ 'brang pa rnams kyis spyan drangs nas tsha ba sgang du phebs de phyogs kyi dang ldan rnams kyi re ba bskangs/ kho pa/ ki nog pa/ ri pa sogs la dge tshul slong sogs bstsal/ slar ri bo cher phebs gzim khang du sku mtshams zhag bdun nang*/ sku skye dang zhal ngo sogs la lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid gnang*/ tshogs chos mu tig phreng ba'i 'grel pa/ phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub skor/ bla ma'i sgrub thabs/ bde dgyes sogs kyi sgrub thabs rnams ljags brtsam mdzad/

chos khri thang du karma si tu dpon slob rnams chibs bsur phebs/ lcags khyi khrums zla'i tshes bdun la 'og min karmar phebs/ si tu sprul pa'i sku dang 'dus sder phyag chen lnga ldan gyi khrid gnang*/ si tu rin po che dang bcas lta steng gi gnas gzigs la phebs/ rje dus gsum chags thogs med par mkhyen sogs/ gsung mgur zhig gnang*/ tshogs 'khor mdzad/ 'du khang du bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnang*/ slar karmar phebs/ sog po'i mi sna gdan 'dren pa rnams kyis mjal/ grwa pa rnams la dge tshul slong gnang*/ rje dgu pa'i dngul sku la rab gnas gnang*/ rje chos dbyings rdo rje'i drung nas bang mi 'byor/ karma'i nang rten rnams mjal/ tshogs su lnga ldan gyi khrid gnang*/ si tu sprul pa'i sku dang 'dus sde bcas la phag mo dang kun rig gi dbang gnang*/ de phyogs kyi dad ldan rnams kyi re ba bskangs nas/ mdo khams mchod rten sgang dang cham gshis brgyud so rag dgon du phebs/ zur mang nas sku skye dpon slob rnams dang karma'i bla ma khams smyon pa sogs bos te dkar zur gyi zlos gzhi bsdum nas khram sogs gnang sde phan tshun mdza' bar mdzad/ be ri lha rgyal mgon gyis gdan drangs nas mchin 'gul du phebs/ de nas bkra shis zur mang du phebs/ bde chen rtser bzhugs/ dpon slob rnams la byang sdom dang*/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ rta mgrin sogs kyi rjes gnang mdzad 'du khang du tshogs gar rgyas par gshams pa'i tshogs dbur spyan drangs/ de nas rim par tsar gshis sogs dang*/ sga thag lag mdor phebs/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung mjal/ lab stod du thu med kyi mi sna 'byor/ rgyal po ja thang du chibs bsur 'byor bas mjal/ nyi zla sum mdor mchod yon lhan rgyas su bzhugs/ rgyal po che chen da'i ching gis brgya 'bul sogs phul/ rnam 'joms dang tshe dbang sogs mdzad/ gser kha drug mdor phebs/ sde pa rin spungs pa sogs snga 'gros su ja 'dren la brdzangs/

gser kha drug mdo skyid pa'i rdzong sogs gsung mgur gnang*/ rgyal nya'i tshes bcu bzhir lcags mo lhun po rtser sprul pa'i sku chos dbyings rdo rje'i drung du thog mar yab sras zhal rgyas/ mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la mnga' gsol te mthon mthing gi cod pan dbu la gsol/ phyag dam sku chas sogs nyer spyad rnams phul/ thu med kho lo jis gdan drangs par phebs pa'i thugs thag bcad/ lcags mo nang sos brgya 'bul bstabs/ rje nyid rang pa tshar phebs nas shar longs spyod kyis nas bya gcig byung*/ sogs yang lcags gnyis kyis ngan shams gyi lung bstan rnams gsungs/ pha wang bon mor tshab tsha mchod yon gyis mjal/ tshab tsha sprul sku sgrub rgyud rab 'phel sogs bsnyen par rdzogs/ mdo steng du dgon gsar rgyag gi sa brtags bslang sogs mdzad/ dus mkhyen sku 'khrungs sa'i rag stag sku 'bum du phebs/ sprul pa'i sku'i chibs bsur dam 'bur mgor phebs/ lhan rgyas sa skyong gling dang 'bum cog sogs su phebs/ der zhabs rjes byon/ si tu sprul pa'i sku dpon slob rnams phebs/ dar rgyas gling du tshe dpag med rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi dbang brgya rtsa brgyad phul/ mtsho kha bla ma sogs la phyag chen gyi khrid dbu tshugs/ lha mo phug tu sku mtshams bdun phrag gcig gnang*/ der yang chu chen gyi mgo bo gangs la thug sogs kyi mgur bzhengs/ dkar brag zho thang du phebs/ sog po thu med dang yong shos phus spyan 'dren pa sleb lhan rgyas pheb par zhal bzhes gnang thob/ mi ngan rnams kyis rgyal ba'i dbang po bon dgon du dbang med kyis spyan drangs te lhan rgyas sog yul du pheb pa ma byung nas rje nyid si tu rin po che zur lcog gnyis bcas sog yul du phebs/ dhis mgon khang du gtor bsngos dang sku rim gtor 'phen mdzad/ rgyal ba dgu pa sku 'khrungs sa'i gnas stag bzang du phebs/ gzhi gsum gyi cho ga thugs brtsam gnang*/

de nas rim par snyi khog bkra shis thang du phebs/ kho lo jis er chi rnams byung*/ snyi rol gyi chol du phebs/ si tu sprul pa'i skur chos drug gi khrid 'debs pa'i dbu btsugs rim par rma chu'i 'gram du phebs bstan pa rgya mtsho brtsams pa'i dbu tshugs/ dpal karma kaṃ tshang rin po che sogs kyi mgur bzhengs/ ra thug brag tu phebs rgyal po che chen dā ching gi chibs bsu ba rnams 'byor/ phyi nyin rgyal po dpon g.yog brgyad brgya tsam chibs bsur phebs nas cha gar bu lag tu rgyal pos 'bul chen bstabs dbu zhwa bzhes/ dbu nas cor du phebs/ rgyal po kho lo ji'i bsu ma rnams 'byor/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bsnyen pa sku mtshams zhag bdun gnang*/ bstan bcos 'chi med bdud rtsi sogs thugs brtsam dang zur ri pa sogs la phyag chen khrid mdzad/ dwa'u del mdar zla ba gcig bzhugs/ si tu rin po che nas dgyes rdor gyi tshogs 'khor mdzad nas bdud rtsi phul bas bde stong gi ye shes bzhad pa'i mgur bzhengs/ rmang lam du bud med gzhon nu ma zhig gis dzā ti'i me tog dang gur gum gyi phur ma phul ba rmis pas gsung mgur mdzad/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas bdag 'jug sogs mdzad/ spyi lan ring mo zhes pa'ang mdzad/ khri shor rgyal mo'i mtsho gzigs/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*/ dus 'khor gyi sbyin sreg mdzad/ nga skyes dbu ru stod du skyes sogs/ thugs dbyung gi mgur mdzad do/ /de phyogs kyi sog sde rnams kyis 'bul zhabs rgya chen phul/ rgyal po kho lo jis rta stong phrag mdzed thags stong*/ mdzo nor stong sogs phul/ dbu zhwa bzhes rgyal po 'khor bcas dge ba la bkod/ dus 'khor dang rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du smin par mdzad/ a chen thang du phebs/ rgyal po che chen dā ching gis spyan drangs 'bul zhabs mdzad/ de nas rim par shel khog rdo zam khar phebs/

hor chang dang bla dgon pa'i 'khrug pa bsdum par mdzad/ shel khog g.yer thang du phebs/ drung don ldan pa'i bzhugs khri kha gsos pa'i 'khar bzhugs de skor rnams kyis 'bul nod bzhes/ mang po zhig la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal/ zur cog gi bla ma rnams la sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang bstsal/ a chen thang gi tsā dhes re su la 'jag spyil bde mchog gi blos bslang gi rnam pa zhig bzos pa'i nang du rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku brnyan yum can dngul las bzhengs pa bzhugs nas rab gnas sogs gnang*/ bde chen gyi rten 'brel thugs chud nas sogs kyi mgur bzhengs/ der sham+bha la dang rigs ldan gyi gzigs snang dang*/ rin po che'i cod pan zhig gnang ba dang*/ bud med zhig gis rgyal po de yi phrin gyi tshig /brda chos mang po zer ba dang*/ lan zhus pa sogs mang po zhig 'dug /ta'u+u sa sngon sgang du lug lo'i lo sar gnang*/ rgya bzas zhabs kyis bcags pa lha sgang du phebs/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i bka' bzhin mchod rten gsar bzhengs rab gnas bcas mdzad/ seng ge dgon gyi karma pak+shi'i sku 'dra gsung byon ma la sku ber sogs phul smon lam mdzad/ de nas rim par dar rtse mdor phebs/ de phyogs rnams kyi 'bul zhabs rgya chen zhus/ mdol nang 'khrug bsdum pa sogs/ mdor na de phyogs kyi skya ser kun chos dang zang zing gis tshims par mdzad/ kong po'i nyang kha ba dang phrag mi'i 'khrug pa dum mdzad/ so sor gnang sbyin rgya chen bstsal/ 'bo gangs dkar gyi nye logs rmu rgyu stod du phebs/ de phyogs kyi skye 'gro rnams gang la gang 'tshams kyis rjes su bzung*/ der rdo la chibs pa'i rjes dang sman chu bzang po zhig thon/ seng ge dgon du phebs nas bdun mtshams zhig gnang der rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gzigs/ ta'u chu lung du zhing skyong sprin nag gi rnam pa can zhal gzigs/ rdo zam khar phebs/

ra mi chos 'byung gsal stong sho sgom gyi sgrub gnas g.ya' khang mjal bar phebs/ hor tshang nas char 'bebs zhus par sku lus bkrus pa'i chu/ chu mig du blugs pa'i mod la char chen babs/ rje dgu pa'i 'khrungs sa stag bzang gi mchod rten zhig gso gnang*/ de nas stag bzang nas chibs bteg ste rim par rma chu kha'i bhi jir tho gol du phebs/ der dbon mdzod dkon mchog phrin las rgya mtsho sogs dang bla ma ba la ba sogs sog 'grul mang pos mjal/ rgyal ba'i dbang po yang lcags dang bcas pa'i sgar pa'ang de 'khris su bzhugs nas zhal rgyas su re na'ang ma grub/ der sku mtshams gnang*/ sog yul gyi 'grul pa rnams kyi re ba bskangs nas brdzangs bda' gnang*/ kre shod lo gang du pheb hor tshang gis gzhi len zhus/ rgyal tshab rin po che gshegs pa'i mchod bsngo rten sogs sleb mchod 'bul sogs mdzad/ kre ka brag mjal/ khrom na chen du wa shul rnams kyis mjal/ byang bdag po dpon slob kyis mjal zhabs dbang sogs stsal/ kaṃ po stag lpags thang du phebs gnas nang mar me mdzad la mchod 'bul dang*/ 'phags yul dgyes rdor lha dgu'i g.yon phyogs su rje dgu pa zhal gzigs/ lta sgom spyod pa'i mgur mdzad/ kaṃ po gnas nang du phebs 'phags yul gong du bdun gsum sku mtshams gnang*/ si tu rin po che pha wang sgam du bcad rgya mdzad/ 'phags yul 'og dang dus mkhyen bzhugs khri steng nas dad ldan rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rlung sems gnyis med kyi khrid mdzad/ si tu dang lhan rgyas mar me mdzad kyi drung du phebs/ stag lpags thang du phebs/ mang po zhig la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ karma'i 'du khang ldebs ris kyi bkod yig mdzad/ 'jang gi spyan 'dren pa rnams kyis mjal/ rgya bya bla mar gcod khrid dang cog gra bar phag mo'i dbang mdzad/ gnas dbon lhun grub kyis brgya 'bul bstabs/ gsung mgur zhig mdzad/

tshes brgyad la byang sems rgyal ba ye shes kyi 'khrungs sa gda' sngo mdor phebs/ e ma gtam snyan dang mi snyan bstod smad la sogs mgur mdzad/ ru yon dpon dang rag stag dpon sogs kyis brgya 'bul phul/ ne tso'i khyu chen lding bas rkyen byas te/ khyod mkha' la lding ba'i ne tso khyod sogs mgur mdzad/ rgya bya bla ma nor bu khu dbon gyis thab bsu ser sbreng bcas nag zla'i nyer gcig la rgya bya dgon du phebs/ 'jang rgyal po'i ja 'dren dang po sleb/ lha mi'i longs spyod char ltar bab pa smos mi long*/ dpal lha mo'i sku bzhengs te mgon khang du bzhugs su gsol/ khing rdzong*/ lcags ra/ mdor sum zom kha sogs brgyud de/ rim par rgyal thang du phebs khyim bdag gcod pa dbang phyug gi gzhi len zhus/ tsa nyi a sbang mgo khang sar mgo pa sogs gra ris kun gyi re 'dod gang bar mdzad/ ba le mtsho khar 'bras zhing dang*/ mu le gram shing*/ sā la/ ma he rnams gzigs pas rgya gar dran gsungs/ kun dga' la thog tu ja kwa kun dga' dpon g.yog rnams sleb/ rgyal bu stag zhi do lar zhon te bsu mar phebs te sgar du byon nas gser gyi bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs phul/ de'i phyi nyin rol mo sna tshogs dang 'phan dang rgyal mtshan sogs mchod pa'i bkod pa du ma dang bcas rgyal po do lar zhon te bsu mar phebs mchod yon lhan rgyas ja gral gnang*/ phyi nyin bsu mi bkod pa bcas/ sba shes pho brang du bzhugs sgar tshang mar bsnyen bskur zhus/ rgyal por tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor las rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur/ rgyal po de chos la dad pa tsam du ma zad rgya ban mkhas pa zhig rgyun du bsten nas theg pa chen po la mos pas khyad par mdo phal po che la sbyangs pa la phyag chen dang chos drug gi smin khrid gnang*/ nyin gcig pho grang gi khyams su rje nyid dang si tu rin po che spyan drangs nas/

gos dar rin po che mang po phyur bur bskang ste phul bar dbu zhwa bzhes/ bka' 'gyur gyi par bzhengs pa'i zhal bkod kyang 'phral 'phral du mdzad/ par byang thugs brtsam gnang ba'i tshe/ zla ba'i gling du 'gro ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta zla bo med pa zhig byung ba la legs sbyar gyi skad kyis gleng bslang mdzad pa'i zin ris kyang yod/ de yang rigs bram ze/ drang srong rgyas pa'i gzhung gi rjes su 'brang ba zhig yin 'dug ces gsung snang*/ paṇ+ḍita de shin tu dad nas gdams pa tshigs bcad zhig dgos zhes zhus par/ legs sbyar du/ sarbadzā ti zhes sogs gnang ba'i bod skad/ bskyed pa thams cad dmigs su med par bsdu/ rlung thams cad ni tshangs pa'i lam du bcings/ rtog pa thams cad ni dran pa'i lcags kyus zung*/ yid la byar med 'di ni rdzogs pa'i rims pa'o// kye ma kyi hud sems can thams cad lta bas bcings// rlung gi rta la rtog pa'i skyes bu g.yo// yid la byas pas bde sdug 'khor bar rgyu// bcings pa grol ba de tshe thar pa yin// zhes pa la ñca nar bris nas gtad pas shin tu mgu bar gyur/ rtsi zhag du mtshan nyid grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs kyi chos khrims bslab ston sogs bgyis/ dbus phyogs kyi chos sde che chung rnams kyi spyi rten sogs dang khams su 'bul sdud la 'ong ba'i rnyed pa ma thob pa rnams kyi re ba thams cad gang bar byas/ de nas khang sar mgor phebs/ si tu rin po ches gtsos mdzad gzhi ma rnams der bzhugs rje nyid kaṃ po gnas nang 'phags yul gong du lo gcig bcad rgyar bzhugs/ lta ba'i skor mgur sarga lnga pa brtsam/ rgyal tshab pa'i dgongs rdzogs la sman lha'i cho ga btsugs/ nang so lhun grub sogs gnas sgo ba rnams la dwags po'i chos bzhi dang gcod gdan thog gcig pa/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor/ chos drug sogs gnang*/ rje dbang phyug rdo rje'i dus chen la dus mchod dang*/ zhing mkha' khyab 'byam klas mu mtha' med sogs thugs brtsam mdzad/

si tu rin po che dpon slob rnams pheb par shangs len du tshes bcu'i cho ga dang tshogs 'khor btang*/ mkha' 'gro ma 'od de 'bum gyi dbu thod du bdud rtsi zhal bskor mdzad/ dgon dkar zhig gso ar+gha'i cho ga gnang bas grog sbur sogs kyis gang ba'i sar 'dug pa la gcig kyang med par song*/ lha chen phyag bzo dang rje dus mkhyen dang rje dgu pa'i sku 'dra nang gzhugs bcas grub/ gsang sngags lha khang du ma mgon mgar gsum dang*/ gtsang khang du brgyad stong pa'i mdo ris sogs phyag ris grub/ dus mkhyen chos khrir phebs nas 'dul ba'i bslab bya gnang*/ byang bdag po sku mched kyis mjal/ dgon dkar lha khang la rab gnas nyin gsum mdzad/ 'di skabs ma ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung*/ de nas 'jang rgyal pos bka' 'ag+r+yur par bzhengs grub par rab gnas la spyan 'dren pa rnams sleb nas 'dob spang phug gi ri mjal dang mtsho mjal mdzad/ bka' 'gyur par yang khang sar mgor spyan drangs 'dug /sa tham rgyal po yang stobs kyi 'byor pas brgya byin la 'gran bzhin sar der phebs/ phyi nyin nas bka' 'gyur par la rab gnas sta gon tshugs/ phyi nyin dngos gzhi bkra shis bcas gnang*/ 'od dkar po 'khyil pa sogs ngo mtshar ba byung*/ 'jang rgyal pos tsi shag dgon gsar 'debs mdzad/ mchod yon lhan rgyas sa tham du phebs/ de nas gsang khog nas dpon slob nyung shas ri bo bya rkang mjal bar phebs/ grong khyer gcig gi nye skor du tsha ba mdzad pas/ rgya ban mo gos hrul gyon pas smyon mar byed pa zhig gis 'di karma pa brdzus mar byed nas phebs pa red zer nas zhal ngo shes song de ni mkha' 'gro ma zhig du 'dug gsungs/ de nub hwa shang bdun bcu tsam yod pa'i lhakhang gcig tu bzhugs/ de rnams kyis mal cha sogs kyis bsnyen bskur bzang po zhus/ yum pha rol phyin ma'i mkha' dbyings sogs gsung mgur gnang*/ pa'u hwa shang zhes pa'i hwa shang grub thob la rtsi ba rkang pa ya gcig gi khar zla ba gsum tsam bsdad zer ba grub thob du rtsi ba des kyang gus 'dud byas/

ri rtser nyan thos chen po 'od srung gi zhabs rjes dang*/ snam sbyar bzhag pa'i rjes dang*/ sgrub chur grags pa'i chu mig mjal/ brag ri shel gyi me long lta bu de'i nang du nyan thos 'od srung gi sku gdung bzhugs pa yin zer ba der phyag mchod smon lam mdzad/ smon tshig gi phyag ris sbyar bar mdzad/ rgya ban mang po 'du ba'i khang bzang zhig du hwa shang zhig gis mgron du bos nas bza' bca' legs par bstabs nas/ 'di so skye dkyus mar mi 'dug /na ning 'jang yul du spyan drangs pa de min nam zer bas sngar karma pak+shis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten de mjal bar phebs 'dod kyang ngo shes dogs nas ma phebs/ de skor du sangs rgyas kyi sku dang*/ mchog zung sogs sangs rgyas pa'i lha khang brgya skor tsam 'dug/ de nas yar log ste go mchod rten chen mor phebs dus 'jang rgyal po phebs bsur byon te mgo sbas kyi pho brang du pheb/ chu na ko ṭar lo gsar dang smon lam mdzad/ rgyal po la nag rgyal phag gsum gyi dbang dang gzhan rjes gnang du ma mdzad/ phyag chen dang*/ sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid gnang*/ zur ri ba sogs kyis tshal pa bka' 'gyur gsung sgrogs mdzad/ nyin gcig rgyal pos bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas sba shes pho brang gi mdo'i chos khrir spyan drangs nas chos khrir bzhugs rgya 'jang gi lo tsā ba gnyis brgyud de rgya 'jang gi khrom rnams la dge ba bcu las brtsam pa'i bka' chos stsal nas/ srog gi mchod sbyin byed pa sogs mi dge bcu las ldog cing yig drug 'dren pa bsnyen gnas srung ba sogs phan bde'i lam bzang por 'god par mdzad/ de nas rim par rgyal thang khang sar mgor phebs/ bka' brgyud rab brtan gling pa sogs la dge tshul slong gnang*/ rjes gnang mang po gnang*/ der rgya gar shar phyogs gau ḍa'i yul nas rigs bram ze lhas byin gyi dge slong zhig byung ba dang 'phros mang po byung ba de la brten nas byang chub sems dpa' kṛ ki'i rtogs brjod yongs su rdzogs pa bsgyur bar mdzad de/

rtogs brjod de'i nang na rgyal po'i bus sha she mi rā zhes yi ge bzhi'i don ma shes pas bud med mkhas ma zhig gis de shes pa'i lo rgyus sogs yod 'dug /der dgon pa gsar rgyag gis dpyad gzigs nas zhal bkod gnang*/ khri rdzong dang rgya bya dgon du phebs/ kaṃ po gnas nang du phebs mar me mdzad kyi drung du gsung mgur gnang*/ 'dam chen rtser brgyud shar phyogs spungs rir phebs/ nang so gdub brgyud pas gtsos de phyogs kyi skye 'gro kun gyi re ba bskangs/ gtsang gshis rdo rje gro lod dang mtshams kyi yi ge drug pa mjal/ mchod pa dang sman bla'i cho ga btang*/ de nas rim par karma dgon du phebs/ si tu rin po che der bzhugs/ tshogs su dam tshig rgya mtsho'i bshad pa dang tsher lung sku skye sogs la chos drug gi khrid gnang*/ lha steng du phebs/ 'gro mgon phug tu tshogs 'khor mdzad/ gzim chung du dpal bram ze chen po'i phyag ris dang*/ 'du khang du rab gnas gnang*/ ri gling gi 'dus sde rnams la kun rig gi dbang sogs dang*/ drung pa gdung brgyud pa sogs la bde mchog dang phag mo'i dbang sogs 'dod chos rnams gnang*/ lha thog pad+ma grags pa seng ge sogs kyis 'bul chen bstabs/

de nas zur mang dgon du phebs/ che tshang 'gyur med snying po sogs bsnyen par rdzogs/ sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed gnang bas me tog gi char bab/ ri khrod pa rnams la nyams len skyong tshul gyi bka' bkod gnang*/ tsher lung pa sogs la chos drug gi bde ba'i bogs 'don sogs kyi khrid mtha' dag bstsal/ gar dbang sprul skus dbur mdzad 'dus pa rnams la dbang chos du ma dang*/ khyad par brgyad stong pa'i ljags bshad gnang*/ drung tsher lung pa nus mthu brnyes pa de la sku rim du mgon po'i mdos bzlog sogs mdzad bcug de nas shor lung dang mi g.yel phug tu phebs tshogs 'khor dang mgur mdzad/ skyo brag dang zur mang bla ma rnams la bde dgyes kyi dbang mdzad/ nang chen go shri pas spyan drangs/ rje de bzhin gshegs pas mi chen po bcu gsum gyi las ka bsnams yong ba'i nang gi ba so'i tham ga dang thang shu sogs gzigs phul spam gzhung du be ri lha rgyal mgon gyis gdan dkar dro zhus/ tshang sar go shri ba yang mjal du byung bas gdan thob sogs sngar lugs bzhin gnang ri bo cher phebs/ chos rje khri gdan zur sogs tshang mar sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang dang*/ dge tshul slong gi bslab pa phog pa sogs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ brtsegs rmang du bum gter du ma bcas lcags ri gsar bzhengs mdzad/ ri bo che ba dang*/ chab mdo ba'i dmag 'khrugs bsdum nas chab mdo ba'i mi nor god pa'i tshab tu rje'i phyag mdzod nas dar gos sogs stong rwa can gyi grangs gnang nas phan tshun 'khrugs long phar zhog shin tu mdza' bar gyur/ de nas khyung por phebs/ khyung po dang ri bo che pa'i yang bsdum mdzad chos khrir pheb dus rdo la zhabs rjes byon/ ri rgyab dgon du phebs rje chos grags rgya mtshos bzhengs pa'i rten gtor la snyan dar sogs phul/ der rdo la zhabs rjes byon/ ba dan dgon du phebs pa'i tshe/

rgya ston go shri pa karma bstan 'dzin dang*/ g.yu ri bla ma/ zhag sgom sku skye sogs lho rgyud dang spo bo phyogs kyi bla dpon rnams kyis mjal/ chos dang zang zing gis tshims par mdzad/ skyi khog mtsho lung du phebs/ sog zam grwa tshang rnams la bsnyen rdzogs gnang*/ rgya shod ban sgar gyi shug yag thang du sgar rgyab/ slob dpon zhabs rjes mjal/ ban sgar ba rnams la tshe dbang sogs de phyogs kyi re ba bskangs/ smir ti mtsho mgor phebs/ 'di rgya dkar nag chu bgos kyi sa yin zer/ grangs reg che/ 'bri khung nas chos rje sku mched rnams phebs/ rmi ti gzhung du dpon karma g.yul rgyal gyis mjal/ mo nam du phebs dbus gtsang gi mi sna ja 'dren pa rnams sleb/ snying drung du rgya gar gyi dzo gi rā hu la dza yar bar ma rab byung gnang*/ de yang legs sbyar gyis so/ /gro ma lung gi phug par tshogs 'khor gnang 'di skor rnams su nyin re bzhin dbus gtsang gi ja 'dren pa rnams 'byor ba khṛr ma longs/ 'phan yul gyi za dam 'od zer dam pa'i gtsug lag khang du phebs/ der nyin byed gling pa'ang gtsang nas phebs grub 'dug cing dbus gtsang gi bla dpon grwa ris thams cad chos dang zang zing gis tshims par mdzad/ bzang gos yug bdun brgya lhag par 'bum gyi gleng gzhi dang mthun pa'i rgyal ba'i sku'i gos thang bzhengs par mdzad/ sa rta gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi dus der gos sku chen mo la rab gnas rgyas pa shis brjod bcas mdzad/ bya bzang brag tu rgya nag lugs kyi dben khang bzo ba'i zhal bkod gnang*/ gangs dkar sde pa khu dbon dang sde pa brag kha ba dpon blon rnams phebs/ lo gsar dang smon lam chen mo rgyas par mdzad/ 'jang rgyal pos phul ba'i mu tig gi zhwa dmar dang rgya dkar nag gi thang ka nor sna sogs khyad par can du ma mjal ka gnang*/ shun nas gdung brgyud rin po che dpon blon rnams zhal mjal la phebs par lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas dgyes par mdzad/

yangs pa can du khor tsam phebs nas de phyogs kyi re ba bskangs nas slar za dam du phebs/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang mdzad/ dpon sas spyan drangs yer par phebs jo bo'i phyag ris gser gling pa'i sku mjal/ lha sar jo mjal la phebs/ jo bo gnyis la snam sbyar khyad par can dang gser gar brdung gi maṇ+ḍal dang sku brnyen so sor snyan shal sogs mchod 'bul phyag smon rgyas par mdzad/ mtshur phur phebs gdung rten rnams dang lha chen la snyan shal bzang gos yug re gser gyi maṇ+ḍal re sogs phul/ phyag mchod smon lam mdzad/ gnas nang du phebs grags seng ba'i sku 'bum la snyan shal dang gser gyi maṇ+ḍal sogs phul/ grwa tshang so sor mang 'gyed rgyas par btang*/ 'bri khung du phebs chos rje sku mched dang zhal rgyas mdzad/ phyogs 'dus rnams la chos drug dang*/ nyin byed gling par 'dul ba'i ṭīka chung 'bru mnan gyi bshad pa gnang*/ zhwa lha khang dang nyang ting 'dzin bzang po'i sgrub phug dang grub thob khyung po'i sgrub phug rnams mjal/ thel du phebs mang 'gyed rgyas par btang*/ tsher lung drung pa kun dga' rnam rgyal drung nas zur mang snyan brgyud skor rnams zhu bar mdzad/ dhi tsha sku skye dang*/ thel mkhan po'i sku skye ngos 'dzin gnang*/ gcung dkon mchog khams su phebs pa'i sku rdzongs phul/ bla ma bsam 'grub grogs mched gtsang pa dang skyid shod pa'i kha mchu'i bsdum la brdzangs/ 'bri khung thil du phebs/ lnga ldan gyi khrid gnang*/ sgar pa rnams la chos drug gi khrid btab/ mkhan pa lung sogs kyi gnas mjal dang*/ spu to ba'i gzim khang dang*/ gzim mal sku 'dra/ ye dharmā phyag ris rnams mjal/ kha rag sgom chung gi gzim khang*/ sne'u zur pa'i gdung 'bum/ sha bo 'bum pa sogs mjal/ za dam du phebs/ mgon khang rten btsugs/ zur ri ba sogs dkon mchog 'bangs kyi bka' 'bum gyi lung mdzad/ mang po zhig la phyag chen gyi khrid gnang*/

'phan yul tshong dus su 'bum dga' ldan mar grags pa/ rje ka ma la shī las dga' ldan du rje byams pa la rab gnas zhus pa de sku 'khor rnams la klog du bcug /dam pa'i sgrub phug tu phebs/ grub chu nas sku 'khor rnams la'ang gnang*/ za dam du phebs lha chen rnams bzhengs gra tshugs/ rgya nag rgyal pos rje de bzhin gshegs pa la phul ba'i dung dkar g.yas 'khyil de mdzod spur bzhugs/ de nas rim par yangs pa can du phebs/ go shri karma chos rgyal de'i mkhan por bskos/ nu ma sgang du dam can la gsol ka btang*/ rin spungs su phebs/ chos sde'i mkhan slob rnams kyis mjal mjal grwa sa'i kun spyod slob gnyer sogs la thugs shin du mnyes par gyur/ rin chen rgyan sprod bcas sde srid chibs bsur byon te rgyal rtser phebs/ chos sde'i mkhan po sogs dang grwa tshang bcas la ja gral gnang*/ zla ba phyed gnyis tsam bzhugs/ sde srid nas 'bul chen bstabs/ sde pa phun tshogs rnam rgyal la rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi dbang brgya dang sgrol dkar dang spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang sogs gnang*/ der bzhugs ring sku 'khor dge bshes rnams dang chos sde'i mkhas pa rnams chos kyi bgro gleng mang po mdzad/ nyin gcig mngon dga'i slob dpon gyis dam bca' bzhag nas phyag phyi'i dge bshes rnams kyis rigs lung yun ring du mdzad/ mkha' reg sprul sku dang rin po che smra seng sogs la rlung sems gnyis med kyi khrid gnang*/ 'thor 'dus pa'i grwa pa mang por phyag chen khrid gnang*/ nyin byed gling pa sogs la lam sgron ljags bshad dang*/ skyes rabs brgya rtsa'i lung stsal/ gangs dkar nas slob dpon zhig gdan nas dus 'khor sogs kyi gar gsan par mdzad/ mkha' reg sprul sku sogs la bsnyen rdzogs gnang*/ don gnyer rnams la nā ro chos drug dang rlung sems dbyer med sogs kyi khrid gnang*/ sngags grwa pa rnams la gur gar dang zhing skyong gi 'chams gnang*/

phyag chen mun sel gyi khrid sogs bstsal/ dpal 'khor chos sder phebs/ rdo bcal du grwa skor ba mang po'i dpang por bzhugs/ dpal 'khor chos sde rnams la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa dang phag mo'i dbang sogs gnang*/ zhing skyong gi gtor 'phen 'chams sogs mdzad/ smon lam chen po mdzad tshogs par blo sbyong don bdun gyi khrid dang mdo ting rgyal dang mdzangs blun gyi lung dang zab mo lta brgyud lugs kyi sems bskyed gnang*/ 'og min dar rgyas gling du phebs/ bla ma mchod pa mdzad/ byams chen gyi rten mjal mdzad/ rin spungs su pheb dpon sa'i rjes sgrub bsngo smon gnang*/ sgrol ma'i drung du mchod 'bul sogs mdzad/ gtsang dpung dbus su 'degs pa nan gyis bshol kyang ma nyan/ lha yul du sku mtshams mdzad nas ri bo bya rkang gi lam yig 'phro mthud mdzad/ jo bo'i gdan sa 'chad mang dang*/ man lung pa'i gdan sar phebs/ mang ja spyi 'bul phyag 'gyed gnang*/ dpal 'khor chos sde dang sna dkar rtser phebs/ ston pa'i 'phel gdung sogs mjal/ sde pa lcam dral rnams la tshe dbang sogs gnang*/ legs bshad gling dang gong dkar gzhis kar phebs/ dol tshal min dang spre zhing gi gnas gzigs mdzad/ grwa thar pa gling du phebs/ 'dus sder rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi dbang gnang*/ gtsang dpung sar phebs/ zhal bkod gnang nas bar ching mdzad/ btsan thang tshe chu 'bum pa sogs mjal/ yar stod sde pa skur ba pas spyan drangs sar phebs/ gtsang pas sne'u gdong bskor bar mi mang po'i srog skyabs mdzad/ lhun po sgang du lho brag sprul sku rgyal ba'i dbang po mjal phyag la phebs/ yab sras lhan rgyas pa'i rten 'byung 'grigs/ 'di skabs nas yab sras lhan rgyas la gegs byed pa'i tshogs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad zin/ gtsang phun tshogs rnam rgyal la tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs bskur/ rgya gar lho phyogs nas 'ong ba'i shib shaṅka ra zer ba de sleb/

sku 'khor du lo lnga'i bar bsdad song gtsang pas sne gdong rtser spyan drangs/ skal ldan mang por chos drug gi khrid gnang*/ rgya gar go ḍa'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍita gcig byung ba dang legs sbyar skad kyis gsung gleng mang po gnang*/ byang chub sems dpa' kri shi'i skyes rabs sogs bstan bcos 'ga' re bsgyur bar mdzad/ de nas kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod du phebs/ grwa tshang gsar rgyag mdzad/ rgyal ba'i dbang po khrom sar spyan drangs nas rje nyid kyi 'phral mkho'i sku chas nyung zad tsam min pa sgar gzhis tshang ma/ gzhi byes kyi chos sde che chung chos gzhi bcas thams cad phyag tu phul/ sgar dmangs dang thor 'dus kyi grwa pa rnams la mos gus chen mo'i khrid dang smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi bslab pa stsal/ gzhis ka gri gur bzhugs skabs khams nas si tu rin po che phebs/ khams nas bya btang 'jang gra ba zhag sgom pa rgya ston chos rje sogs 'byor bar phyag chen dang gcod khrid sogs 'dod chos rnams gnang*/ sras mkhar du phebs ma hā mā yā'i sgrub mchod zla ba gcig la mdzad/ rje mar pa'i sku 'dra rtsa ris mar dngul gyi dbu rgyan dang ting phon gyi sku ber sogs phul/ si tu rin po cher mi bskyod zhabs kyi bka' 'bum lung gnang*/ rgya nag nas san+yashi gnyis dang rgya gar nas dzo gi gnyis dzhaṃ ga ma gcig sogs 'dzom byung*/ rgyal ba'i dbang po yang mtshams khong nas phebs/ lhan rgyas khon mthing lha khang dang mkhar chu rtser phebs gnas mjal mdzad/ bya yul nas 'brug sprul skus mjal/ gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal 'das sar spyan drangs te si tu rin po che bcas rgyal mkhar rtse dang pa nam du phebs sde pa'i rjes bsgrubs bsngo ba sogs gnang*/ dbang lung zhu ba'i pho nya ba tsher lung kun dga' rnam rgyal las shang chos dang*/ lam 'bras skor/ ngan rdzong snyan brgyud/ zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum sogs gsan yol mo sprul skus mjal dbang lung sogs kyis thugs 'dod bskangs/

sde pa rin spungs pa'i sku mched gnyis la dge bsnyen gnang che bar karma chos grags dpal bzang dang chung bar karma chos kyi nyi mar btags/ zang zang ne'u ring pa dpon slob rnams kyis mjal tshigs gsum ṛm nod du dge slong gi sdom pa dang dbang chos sogs gnang*/ legs bshad gling gi grwa pa zhig gis nyin gling pa'i tshogs su dam bca' bzhag pa'i tshogs dbur phebs bzhad gad theg pa byung*/ steng skyes pa'i sras su rgyal tshab rin po che'i sprul sku 'khrungs pa rgyal ba'i dbang po nas thugs thag chod/ mkha' reg sku skye sogs la ngo sprod bdun ma'i 'grel pa rje brgyad pas stsal ba'i khrid dang*/ mngon pa'i ṭīka chen gyi bshad pa gnang*/ rtogs ldan ngag dbang rgyal pos o rgyan gyi skad cha dang gur gum sogs phul/ de nas thob rgyal du phebs nas/ rgyal tshab sprul pa'i skur tshe dbang dang ber gyi rjes gnang mdzad/ tre chung sprul skur shang chos kyi lung dang*/ legs bshad gling pa sogs la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa gnang slar pa nam du phebs sku mtshams bdun phrag gcig gnang*/ de nas rgyal ba'i dbang po gtsang sde srid karma bstan skyong dbang pos spyan drangs par chibs bsu la zhag gcig snga bar phebs phyi nyin yab sras zhal 'dzom sde srid nas rin chen rgyan sprod dang bsu ba'i bkod pa bcas rgyal mkhar rtser phebs/ karma bstan skyong dbang por tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs gnang*/ rgyal tshab rin po cher rje brgyad pa'i bka' 'bum gyi lung mdzad/ bla ma drung yig pa sogs la phyag chen gyi khrid gnang*/ 'brug nas sprul sku dpag bsam dbang po phebs thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ skar dmangs la rje brgyad pas brtsams pa'i phar phyin gyi man ngag zab rgyas snang ba'i khrid dbu tshugs/ chos lung du phebs/ rang byon 'phags pa u khang dang*/ kha che paṇa chen gyi na bza' gsol lhung*/ thugs rje chen po'i shing sku sogs dang gling ras dang phag gru'i gzim phug sogs mjal/

'bras yul skyed tshal du phebs/ byams chen rab 'byams pa'i dngul gdung sogs mjal/ gangs rar phebs/ brag nag tu gser gling pa'i thugs dam rten byams pa'i sku mjal/ thob rgyal sngags grab sogs la phag mo'i dbang bskur/ skyer skang pa'i sgrub phug dang lo chen skyabs mchog dpal gyi gdan sa chos 'khor sgang mjal bar phebs/ chos lung tshogs pa'i nang rten rnams mjal/ rgyal mkhar rtser phebs/ sgar dmangs rnams la shing rta'i srol 'byed man ngag snang ba'i khrid btsugs/ sku cung zad bsnyun pas rgyal ba'i dbang po nas/ rgyal ba mchog gi gdul bya'i zhing khams 'dir sogs zhabs brtan phul/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i phyag na rdo ba'i sa yig rang byon gsal ba zhig 'dug pa gnang nas smon lam kyang mdzad par/ lan tshigs bcad ma zhig phul/ rgyal ba'i dbang por rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi ljags bshad sogs phul/ kre chung sprul skur bsdus gra'i 'dzin chos btang*/ cog gra ba rnams la rje brgyad pas mdzad pa'i 'jigs chog btsugs/ rgya gar gyi dzo gi mang po sleb gsung 'phros gnang*/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i rmang lam bka' sam la zhu lan phul/ mgo zla'i nyer gcig nyin rje nyid ras bud la bzhugs/ de nub gzim gur la drod dang 'ja' sprin 'khrigs/ tre chung sprul sku sogs la zab mo nang don gyi bshad pa dang 'dzin chos gnang*/ gtsang sde srid nas 'bul mo che bstabs/ cog grwa ba rnams kyi tshogs dbur phebs 'jigs mdzad sgrub mchod mdzad/ drug cu pa'i gtor chog gnang*/ yar stod pa dang sde srid la tshe dbang gnang*/

de nas rje nyid legs bshad gling du phebs/ gangs dkar du sde pas tshes bcu'i 'chams gzigs phul tshong dus rgyal pos zhabs brtan phul/ slob dpon pad+ma la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig gnang*/ gdan sa thel du phebs/ rten gsum rnams mjal/ mchod rdzas rnams sprod len mdzad/ lo mjug dus rim dang lo sar gnang*/ bca' khrims gsar bsdams mdzad/ zangs ri dang phag mo gru'i mkha' 'gro'i gzim khang du tshogs 'khor mdzad/ sde pa grags kha bas gdan/ 'dzam gling yongs grags dang rin po che smra seng gnyis bgro gleng mdzad/ bde chen tshal du phebs rgya ras kyi sku tshigs la byon pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sku mjal/ bsam yas su phebs dbu rtse sogs mjal/ mchim phur phebs/ ār+ya pa lor tshes bcu'i 'chams bcas gnang*/ pe har gyis zhabs brtan phul phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs/ sgrags sngags grwa dang*/ dol dang skyi shod rnams su phebs/ lha rje phug pa zhes jo bo'i gzim phug mjal/ gangs dkar du phebs sde pas bsnyen bkur dang gur gar gzigs/ bstan 'dzin sku skye dang phug pa sku skye gnyis la mtshan nyid kyi pusti phyi nang gi bshad pa gnang rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur/ chos dbang gi gdan sa shug gseb tu phebs/ sku 'dra phyag nas ma mjal/ 'bre shes rab grags kyi gdan sa 'chad mang du phebs/ kha reg sku skyer thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid gnang*/ jo mo kha rag gi gnas gzigs la phebs/ karma bstan srung gis bzhengs pa'i bcu gcig zhal gyi skur rab gnas mdzad/ bod 'brug bla brang du spyan drangs der bla ma zhang gi phyag nas ma mgon po phyag bzhi pa lcam dral gyi sku mjal snyan dar dang phrin bcol sogs mdzad/ gangs dkar nas gdung brgyud rin po che phebs pa dang lhan du jo mo shar mgul gyi sgrub sder phebs gnas mjal gnang*/ yar 'brog khri dpon pas spyan drangs sna dkar rtser phebs de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung mjal/

gangs phug gi gnas gzigs mdzad/ dkon mchog yan lag gi sgrub khang du re zhig sku mtshams mdzad/ rgyal mkhar rtser phebs/ rgyal tshab rin po cher mngon pa'i lung dang*/ tshe ring ma'i cho ga gsar 'dzugs gnang skabs glo bur du kha tshubs byung bar dga' gdong du phebs der rgyal ba'i dbang po phebs te lhan rgyas sde srid gtsang pas spyan drangs te bsam 'grub rtser phebs/ rdo rje gdan gyi dkor gnyer pa rā hu la'i grogs mched sleb par grub thob du grags pa stod hor rgyal po sogs kyis bla mchod du bskur ba tsin+tarū pa'i zhu yig dang rin po che'i bgrang phreng bcas 'byor bar zhu yig legs sbyar de bod skad du bsgyur bar mdzad pa/ dpal ldan khyod kyi srid pa ni// rnal 'byor de las rnal 'byor gyi// dang po srid par bsgrub de na// byang gi yul du gang thos pa// chos kyi sku can legs par sdom// ser skya 'dra rnams kyi cod pan// 'gro ba'i bla ma lha yi lha// smon lam smra ba bdag po'i bdag/ mchog gi dbang phyug bdud dang bcas// snyan grags kyi ni bkra shis can// khyab bdag grags pas brgyan rnams kyang*// gang gi ngur smrig na bza' ni// de yi grwa la'ang phu dud byed// bdag gis byas pa'i las rnams ni// las byed nyid na mi dgos te// gang gis nyin mo'i dus blangs pa// de yi nyin mor cis mi bsrungs// 'di ni bla ma'i lam las nyin mo bzhin bdag gis chub par byas nas bla ma'i yang dag pa'i rtogs pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ gzhan yang paṇ+ḍita nyi shu rtsa lnga so so'i ched du bsngags pa'i sha lo ka re re yang 'dug par zhu lan mdzad/ kā shi pu ra nas dzo gi zhig byung bar lam yig sogs byin/ yang wā ra ṇā si nas s+thā shi ba zhes pa'i san+ya shi sgra ka tsān sogs shes pa zhig 'dug pa lo gcig tsam bsdad pas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dzin pa dang las 'bras la yid ches par byas to song*/ sde srid nas lhan rgyal la 'bul chen bstabs/

mkha' reg sprul pa'i skur sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid dang rgyal tshab rin po cher khrid 'ga' re gnang*/ gtsang sde srid la tshe dbang brgya rtsa gnang dzo gi zhig dang bram ze mā la bid+ya zhes pas lus rtsed sna tshogs kyi gzigs phul/ rgya gar nas san+ya shi dang dzo gi dzhaṃgham sogs lnga bcu rtsa drug tsam byung bar so sor gnang cha dang lam yig sogs byin/ 'jang rgyal po nas bka' 'gyur gyi par phud 'bul mi rnams 'byor/ rgyal rtser phebs te sku mtshams bdun gsum gnang*/ 'og min gling du phebs te rje dgu pa'i dngul sku mjal bas zhwa phud mdzad/ mkha' rong gangs sdug tu phebs bdun mtshams zhig gnang*/ sna dkar rtser phebs dpon sa dang 'dzam gling chos 'khor gyi bla ma sogs la blo sbyong don bdun gyi khrid gnang*/ de nas gangs dkar du spyan drangs nas phebs/ spyan snga bka' brgyud kyi rten bzhengs rnams la rab gnas mdzad/ legs bshad gling du phebs bka' chos 'ga' re gnang*/ mtshur phur phebs/ 'og min gling gi lha khang la gser thog gsar bzhengs mdzad/ rje nyid kyis mkhan po dang*/ dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtshos las slob/ si tu rin po che nas gsang ston mdzad de kha bskang dang bcas karma pa chos dbyings rdo rje dgung lo nyer gcig pa tshigs gsum rim nod kyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang*/ dpal ldan chos dbyings mchog gi rdo rje phrin las mngon par mtho ba'i dpal gyi mtshan gsol/ rgyal tshab rin po che grags pa mchog dbyangs dgung lo dgu pa rab tu byung*/ dpal ldan grags pa mchog dbyangs 'gro ba'i khyu mchog kun bzang rnam par rol pa'i dpal gyi mtshan gsol/ dgongs gcig gi lung dang ljags bshad gnang*/ gzhan yang mang po zhig la bsnyen rdzogs gnang*/ sde pa thob rgyal ba'i rjes sgrub la phebs/ dge rgyas g.yul rgyal ming sring gi mjal/ ba le rab 'byams pa yangs can gyi mkhan por bsko ba gnang*/ za phur phebs nas gnas gzigs mdzad/

lha phu dang rgya tsho bas spyan drangs te de dag tu phebs dpal chen du phebs/ rgod phrug sangs rgyas skyabs kyi rtogs 'bul lan dang dge bshes 'gas mdzod kyi mchod brjod skabs kyi dogs gcod kyi dri len brtsam/ za phu gdan sa pa sogs la mkha' 'gro snying thig gi khrid gnang*/ gter lung gsum par phebs phyag mchod smon lam gnang gter lung bdun par phebs spyan ras gzigs zhal gzigs/ yangs pa can du zhwa dmar nag rgyal tshab si tu bcas lhan rgyas mdzad/ tshes bcu'i 'chams gzigs phul/ 'dus sder dus 'khor gyi dbang gnang nas mtshur phur phebs lcags ri bzo ba'i sa chog sogs gnang*/ pa tshab lo tsā'i gdung 'bum la zhabs skor gnang*/ za dam du phebs sna'i btsun pa karma dpal 'byor chos bzang gdan sa thel gyi slob dpon du bskos/ dus mkhyen sgrub phug bya bzang brag tu phebs/ gsung mgur gnang*/ gnas nang du phebs gzhi byes kyi gra pa rnams la phyag chen dang chos drug bdud rtsi'i nying khu'i khrid dang khrid thung pusti'i lung mdzad/ mtshur phur phebs rgyal ba'i dbang por dus 'khor/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ ber nag can sogs kyi dbang bka' sogs phul/ cha gar/ khar+kha sogs sog po'i mi sna mang po slebs/ sog yul du 'gro mkhan rnams la sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang mdzad/ ras pa lnga bcu skor gyis ras bud btang*/ gos rgyu legs kho na la gnas bcu'i gos yol chen mo bzhengs par mdzad/ mtshur grwa tshang gi dus 'khor mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs kyi sgrub mchod gzigs pa gnang*/ sog po gzhung drug rnams la bka' shog sogs brdzangs/ si tu rin po cher tshe ring ma'i dbang dang mtshur phu'i 'dus sder phag mo'i dbang sogs gnang*/ rgyal ba'i dbang po dang rgyal tshab par ma hā mā yā'i dbang dang rgyal tshab par gur drag dang*/ bde mchog lha lnga/ phyag bzhi pa rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu lnga/ 'dus pa zhabs lugs/ dril bu lus dkyil/

bde mchog dkar po/ gza' yum rnams kyi dbang rjes gnang mdzad/ skyor mo lung dang gzhong pa lha chur phebs/ snye thang du jo bo rin po che'i sku 'bum/ lhung bzed/ 'khar gsil/ rje nā ro pa'i gdung rus bzhugs pa'i mchod rten rnams mjal/ tshong dus rgyal po sogs la thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung stsal/ g.ya' bzang dang gri gu dgon sogs brgyud lho brag sras mkhar du rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhabs pad du phebs/ chu dbar du bla ma karma nor ldan sogs slob dpon du bskos/ yab sras gsum kar rje dpa' bos 'bul chen bstabs/ nyi lder phebs spel chung jo bo mjal dhi tsha sprul skus 'bul zhabs zhus/ lo mjug dgu gtor dang me yos gnam lo gsar tshes kyi smon lam sogs mdzad/ sras mkhar du rje mar pa'i sku brnyan drung du yab sras lhan rgyas bzhugs zhag gnang*/ lha lung chos sde dang rnam rgyal stag rtse brgyud/ lhan rgyas gdan sa thel du phebs/ rgyal ba'i dbang por sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang phul/ bsam yas su phebs sems bskyed byang chub gling du rgyal ba'i dbang po rgyal tshab bcas la smon 'jug sems bskyed mdzad/ mchims phur phebs gsang 'dus las byang gi sgo nas tshogs 'khor mdzad/ sgrags kyi yongs rdzong du phebs rgyal ba'i dbang por gro lod dbang phul/ 'u shang rdo'i gtsug lag khang dang*/ snye thang jo bo'i drung du smon lam sogs mdzad/ mtshur phur phebs bo dong 'chi med sprul sku bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ 'chi med ngag gi dbang po phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi mtshan dang gu shri'i las tshan gnang*/ dus 'khor dbang sogs bzhed pa thams cad bkang bar mdzad/ mtshur phu ba rnams la 'jigs mdzad cho ga'i lung dang*/ drug cu'i gtor 'phen gnang*/ yangs can nas 'gul lag sogs brgyud ko khyim du phebs/ dge 'dun rnams la sra brkyang 'ding ba sogs yod/ hor dpon sa skyong dang 'brang du bla ma sogs kyis 'bul zhabs zhus/

cog grwa bar 'jigs mdzad dbang bskur/ rim par yangs can du phebs yab sras zhal 'dzom gnang rgyal tshab par rje brgyad pa'i bka' 'bum lung 'phro dang*/ 'bri khung gshag ram sgrub sder lnga ldan khrid gnang*/ sku 'tshams zhag bdun mdzad/ za dam du phebs bla ma lha khang sogs la rab gnas mdzad/ khams nas zur mang pa'i 'bul skyel ba rnams 'byor gnas mdo karma chags med za dam gyi bsgrigs la bzhugs par rje gar dbang drug pa nyid nas skyes bu dam pa yin par dbugs dbyung mdzad nas rim pas mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs du ma dang dbang lung gdams ngag mang du gnang*/ pha dam pa'i phug tu zhag bzhugs gnang der gnas rnams la pha dam pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnang*/ skyer sgang pa'i sku 'bum dang sku 'dra mjal/ mtshur phur phebs zur mang sku skye karma bstan skyong dang tsher lung pa sogs kyis khams su phebs dgos pa'i zhu nan dang 'bul chen bstabs/ yangs mtshur gyi grwa mang la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur/ lo mjug dus gtor gyi tshogs dbur phebs/ sa 'brug gi lo sar sogs gnang slar za dam du phebs nas smon lam chen mo btsugs/ thang sag tu pheb/ pu to ba'i thugs dam rten thub sku dang*/ paṇ+ḍita gser gyi go cha'i chos dung*/ pa tsham lo tsā'i 'jam rdor gyi rgya dpe rnams mjal/ glang ri thang pa'i shangs mtshal gyis bzhengs pa'i zhal thang yang mjal/ rgyal tshab sogs la lam sgron khrid gnang*/ za dam nas bteg nyan po sher grags kyi gnas su rma bya chen mo'i sku mjal/ lhan rgyas stag lung du phebs/ thang pa'i dngul gdung dang dngul sku sogs mjal/ se le nas/ pu to ba'i yum gyi skye ba'i shig 'bum du grags pa dang*/ pu to ba'i sku 'dra gsung byon ma mjal/ nyin gling par nang don dang byams chos lnga sogs kyi lung gnang*/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhabs brtan 'bul chen phul/ tsher lung drung pa gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul gnang*/

za dam gyi nang rten rnams gzigs phul/ rje dgu pa'i dngul sku sogs la rab gnas gnang*/ za dam nas yab sras gsum ka chibs bteg/ rag yar/ sgar phu gnas nang rnams su rim par phebs nas mtshur phur phebs/ gnas mdo karma chags med zhabs tshigs gsum gyis bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan dang po karma slob lam gnang yang phyis nas rten 'byung gis karma chags med du gnang*/ de nas gtsang sde srid nas spyan drangs te sgar chen bteg/ g.yung du phebs 'og min gling gi gser thog gsar bzhengs la phyag nas gnang*/ rin chen rgyan sprod dang ser sbreng gi bkod pa bcas rgyal mkhar rtser phebs/ rgyal ba'i dbang por dbang bka' 'ga' re dang*/ rgyal tshab rin po che dang bo dong 'chi med 'od zer sprul skur sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang*/ sde sṛd la sgrol dkar rjes gnang sogs mdzad/ tre chung sogs la bsnyen rdzogs dang zab mo nang don bshad pa gnang*/ ras chung sbug sprul sku bya ba'i zhal ngor 'khrungs pa gdan sar bkod pa dang*/ lo mjug dus gtor dang sa mo sbrul lo'i lo sar smon lam chen mo sogs rgyas par mdzad/ phyag sbal du chud pa'i btson mang po 'don par mdzad/ 'bre shes rab 'bar dang rgyang rtse chos rgyal ba'i sgrub gnas ri khrod dga' ldan du phebs/ lhan rgyas dpal 'khor chos sder phebs rten mjal dang*/ 'brang rtse rgyal byed tshal gyi rten mjal gnang*/ rtsib gnas par du mes dbon gyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams mjal/ la nam dga' ba gdong du phebs byams pa gsung byon ma sogs mjal/ mkhar chen rtse dang rnam gling klu sdings su phebs/ tre nag tshang pa mang pos mjal/ rgya tshor phebs 'chi med sprul skur sems bskyed kyi bslab pa phog 'jigs byed dang phyag bzhi pa'i dbang bskur/ mang po zhig la le'u bdun ma'i lung mdzad/ dkar po brag tu rten rnams la rab gnas mdzad lung mang po gnang*/ 'ba' ra ba'i sgrub gnas mjal 'ba' ra ba'i gsung mgur lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi khrid gnang gser mdog can du phebs/

shāka mchog gi sku 'bum la phyag mchod sogs mdzad/ 'dus sder lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa'i gsung chos rgya cher bstsal/ dge bshes rnams kyis chos kyi 'bel gtam mdzad/ mang 'gyed rgyas par gnang*/ slar gzhes ka rtse'i bkra shis dga' tshal du yab sras lhan rgyas gnang nas snar thang du phebs rten mjal dang*/ chos sde'i mkhan slob sogs dge bshes rnams dang zhabs 'bring na yod pa'i bka' ram pa rnams dbu ma'i lta grub la 'bel gtam mdzad du bcug / chu mig sgrol ma mjal/ lhan rgyas khro phur phebs dge 'dun rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig gnang*/ gnyan lo'i gnas gzhir phebs/ gnyan los rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i sku mjal/ pheb lam du bar chad bsrung bar khas blangs/ de nas sa skyar phebs rten gsum rnams mjal/ bdag po mthu stobs dbang phyug dang mjal phrad mdzad/ rgyal gyi shrir phebs rgod tshang pa'i sgrub gnas brag rgod tshang can du zhag gsum bzhugs/ ri rtser lhan rgyas phebs/ grub thob brgyad cu zhal gzigs 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub/ rgyal ba'i dbang por rje rgod tshang pa zhal gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba'ang 'dug /shig nad phug dang bsam gtan gling du phebs/ yol mo sprul skus mjal/ ding ri gla 'khor du phebs phyi nang gi rten rnams mjal/ chu mig sdo 'bum dang*/ ra chu/ ra lung brin gyi la so phug rnams brgyud de/ chu dbar du sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog gi sgrub sder phebs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mchod gar dang*/ rje mi la snam sbyar gsol ba zhig zhal 'dzum bag bcas zhal gzigs nyams 'ur te phebs lam sogs gar phebs med pa byung*/ chos 'byung steng du gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i sa chog mdzad/ lha khang mgon khang rten bzhengs rgya chen mdzad/ skabs der sde pa spel byung ba dkon mchog phrin las rgya mtshos phul ba'i rdzong gzhis phul zhing nyi lde dgon du lha khang mgon khang rnam sras khang sogs bzhengs nas skya bzo tsam grub pa'i skabs sde pa gshegs par rje nyid nas bka' gnang ste mtha' grub par mdzad/

byang sems zla rgyal gyis bzhengs pa'i spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong gi sku phyag nas bdud rtsi 'bab pa spel byung jo bor grags pa de spyan drangs te gtsang khang du bzhugs brang khang rnams dang lcags ri dang bcas pa grub/ dge 'dun phyed dang nyis brgya las mi nyung ba bcas dang*/ de dang mthun par bkra shis dge 'phel du dge slong drug bcu tsam la spel byung gi sa cha'i steng nas phog rkyen sbyar bar mdzad do//

de nas rgyal ba'i dbang po gangs ri mjal bar phebs pa'i skyel ma mdzad nas yab sras gnyis 'bral mi phod pa lta bus rje nyid steng zhes bya bar phebs nas/ e ma ho yongs 'dzin mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug nyid sogs/ sku tshe de yi 'dul bya re zhig rdzogs nas sku phyi ma'i rten 'byung gi gsung mgur mdzad/ chu dbar dwags po phug tu sku mtshams zhag bdun pa zhig mdzad/ sgrub sde rnams la phyag chen rgyas khrid dang*/ mdo ting rgyal gyi bshad pa gnang*/ jo bo sga ru'i bla mtsho dang mkha' 'gro bye ba'i khrus mtsho rnams mjal/ zhabs phyi rnams kyis bzhugs khri byin rlabs 'byung gnas brtsegs/ rje mi la'i dom phug tu phebs/ don gnyer rnams la gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs kyi lung gnang*/ tshe ring ma dang mthing gi zhal bzang ma'i bla mtsho mjal/ sga ru bu gar sku 'khor rnams la bla ma rgyal ba rgya mtshor gsal ba'i rnal 'byor gnang*/ chu dbar sgrub sde rnams dwags po bka' 'bum gyi lung mdzad/ yam bu rgyal po'i zhu yig la legs sbyar gyi zhu len na ga rar bris pa bskur/ gser 'phru'i bzo bo rnams brdzangs/ spo mthor rgya bal du phebs pa'i lha bsangs mdzad/ de nas rje nyid rgya bal du phebs par sgrub sde rnams kyis spro bder skyel thung zhus/ gnas nyer bzhi'i nang tshan/ go dā ba ri/ snyan g.yon du phebs/ der yod rnams la phag mo'i bskyed rdzogs gsungs/ la phyi lung bstan phug dang bdud 'dul phug ras chen phug gi zhabs rjes dang nang rten rnams mjal/ brod pa phug tu phag mo'i cho ga mdzad/ gnya' nam tshong dus su phebs der 'dus rnams kyi ngor dbu zhwa bzhes/ bde chen steng du phebs/ rgod tshang ba'i dbu lo bub bzhugs pa'i sku mjal/ 'gram dang*/ sdum khang sogs brgyud nas phebs/ li ti rgyal pos mjal/ yang la ko ṭa dang sid+bharabha/ bla ma spyan 'dren sogs brgyud grub thob brgyad cur grags pa bcos ma'i phug pa mang po yod pa deng phebs/

yam bu'i blon po mā na pi ṣa sogs g.yog mang po bsu mar sleb/ tsang kur gi khyung rang byon sar phebs/ khyab 'jug gi sku khyung la zhon pa de'i dbu nang du khyung rang byon de 'dug zhib par ma mthong*/ mkhan slob chos gsum gyi 'khrungs rabs grong mas bzhengs pa'i mchod rten bya rung kha shor te/ bal po rnams khas sot+ya zhes zer ba de mjal phyag mchod smon lam sogs rgyas par mdzad/ der yod rnams la sems bskyed kyi khrid gnang*/ phag mo'i gsang chu dang*/ gu lang gser khang dang lcags kyi rtse gsum/ klu nor rgyas kyi lha rten sogs mthong gsungs 'dug/ phyi nyin yam bu rgyal po lak+ṣinarasiṃmal+las glang chen gnyis dang bsu ba'i bkod pa bcas byung bar glang chen chibs te yam bur phebs/ shing kun chung ba dang nags rin gyi bzhugs khri mjal/ rgyal po'i bla ma paṇ+ḍita zhig dang legs sbyar gyis sgra tshad sogs kyi 'bel gtam byas pas ma hā' paṇ+ḍita zhes ha las par gyur/ rgyal pos mjal dar phul bas rgyal por dge legs kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ bram ze'i paṇ+ḍita zhig gis bod kyi yul dang rgyal po ji lta bu sogs legs sbyar gyis dris byung bar/ rje nyid kyis chos rgyal mes dbon rnams kyi paṇ+ḍita rnams spyan drangs tshul dang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyis bod yul bdag gir mdzad tshul sogs legs sbyar gyis gsungs pas rgyal po shin tu rangs par gyur/ thang bi ha ra zhes a ti sha'i bzhugs gnas dang rje btsun byams pa'i sku mjal/ 'phags pa dza ma li dang shing kun mjal phyag mchod smon lam rgyas par mdzad/ 'dzum lang rgyal po bi kra ya shas mjal/ go rgyal pos snyan pa thos te phal par brdzus nas mjal te 'bul nod zhus/ bal po'i bzo bo rnams kyis gdan nas bsnyen bkur dang*/ shing kun du gtsang pa rgyas pos tshogs 'khor zhus/ phyi nyin yam bu rgyal pos bsnyen bkur byas/ dur khrod ra mdo li dang*/

a khang*/ yang le shod a su ra rnams su phebs nas mchod 'bul smon lam sogs mdzad/ rgya gar du pheb par bzhed kyang rten 'byung ma 'grigs/ ye rang rgyal po sid+dhi na ra siṃha mal+la dpon slob 'bangs bcas kyis mchod rdzas dang rol mo du ma dang glang po che gnyis khrid nas spyan 'dren la byung bar rje nyid glang po la chibs te sangs rgyas kyi smon lam lnga brgya pa zhal 'don mdzad/ jo bo bru khang gi drung du gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa mdzad do/ /rje 'dis zla ba phyed kyi gso sbyong ni chags med yin pa la sogs pa de ltar zhib pa'i rnam thar ni stod smad kun tu brir ma langs pa shes par bya'o/ /rgyal pos 'bul ba rgya cher phul nas chos 'brel zhus pas 'o skol gyi ston pa'i gso sbyong tshigs bcad gsum las brtsam ste legs sbyar gyi skad du rgyas par bshad/ sa sbrul mgo zla'i rgyal ba dang por rdo rje gdan du yan lag bdun pa sogs kyi gsol 'debs smon lam tshigs bcad dang mchod rdzas 'bul bar brdzangs bda' mdzad/ de nas ye rang rgyal pos pho brang du spyan drangs/ nya phyis kyi ka ṭo ra dang*/ mu tig gi mdzod sogs 'bul ba mang po bstabs/ rnam rgyal ma dang rnam 'joms kyi khrus sogs mdzad/ blon po kal+ya na zhes pa'i gnas po des be'u phrug bzang po sogs phul/ rgyal po 'od zer go cha dang bal bza' khri btsun gyi brgyud pa kho khaṃ rgyal pos glang po che zung rgyan gyis spras pa dang*/ rta mchog gser sga sogs rgyan ldan dang rgyal po'i sras gnyis sogs bsu ba'i bkod pa dang bcas rje nyid glang chen la chibs te grong khyer gyi byang sgo nas phebs/ pho brang du spyan drangs te shing tog sogs dngos rdzas du mas mchod/ rgyal po dgyes pa'i gsung gleng mang du mdzad bas dad cing gus par gyur/ paṇ+ḍita ke sho gi ris mjal chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad pas dad de/ srin bal gyi gos zhig 'dug pa khyod bsod nams kyi zhing du 'dug zer nas sku la gsol bar byas/

rdza mkhan rnams kyi bum pa bzo ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇasār gzigs/ la hor gyi yul nas 'ong ba'i sog po bzhis me mda' dang phub phul ba bzhes sgrol ma'i sku byin chen de mjal/ ke sho gi ri la 'chings grol dang thar pa dris par/ bhutā t+ma nod+dha ba man sogs legs sbyar du smras pa bod skad du bsgyur gnang ba/ 'byung ba rnams las yid 'byung yid las ni/ dbang po byung bas yul la spyod par gyur// yid du 'ong la chags dang mi 'ong las// sdang dang gzhan las nga rgyal yul nye bar// len de las skyes 'di de de ltar 'chings// yul rnams so sor sdud dang srog rtsol dang*// 'dzin pa de las dga' ba rjes su dran// dben las skyes pa'i bsam gtan rtse gcig tu// ting 'dzin yang yang goms thob rnal 'byor pa// dbang po 'byung ba g.yo med rnam par grol// zhes sogs paṇ+ḍi ta de dang gsung gleng mdzad pa'i zin ris lam yig du gnang 'dug /paṇ+ḍi tas sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' dang chos tshul gsung par bskul/ shākya'i rgyal po'i gso sbyong gi tshigs bcad las brtsam ste chos mang du gsungs pas kho rang shin tu dad par mdzad 'dug paṇ+ḍi tar dris pa'i skor 'di la jo nang rje btsun gyi dpyad pa 'ga' re mdzad 'dug na'ang legs sbyar gyi skad de ni sgra gzhung dang yang mthun par 'dug cing*/ sbyor drug gi tha snyad de 'dra phyi rol pa la'ang yod nges su 'dug ces bdag gi bla ma gsungs/ rgya gar gyi sgyu ma mkhan zhig gis sgyu ma'i rtsed mo mang po gzigs phul 'dug /rje mi las mgon po rdo rje rjes su bzung ba'i gnas kun+tir phebs/ sha ba dang khyi'i rjes sogs mjal/ karma pa'i drung du rgya gar gyi ne'u le 'bul mi btang*/ rin chen tshul gyi gtsug lag khang mjal/ shing kun la gser gdugs phul na yang rlung ches pas mi brtan zer bas phyogs bzhir rgyal ba rigs bzhi bzhugs pa'i bum pa nor bu rta babs byed pa'i bkod pa mdzad/
