rgyal po'i mchod gnas paṇ+ḍita la rlung gi skor dri ba mdzad/ de nas rgyal pos pho brang du spyan drangs nas dngul sogs 'bul chen bstabs/ dbu zhwa bzhes bsngo smon shis brjod mdzad/ phyi nyin blon po gnyis mngags byung ste/ nged la pha rol gyi dgras mi tshugs pa dang*/ phyogs 'dir ser ba mang pos gnod pas de la dgongs gtad dgos zhes sogs 'dod don mang bar de dang de yi lan gnang*/ brag la phyag mdzub kyi rjes byon/ bal bza' khri btsun gyi zhing skal ne'u sing du gyur pa dang bod thang gi mgon po sogs mjal/ pho brang gi nye skor 'jigs byed kyi sku yod pa zhig tu bos nas rgyal po dang sras pradhā na mal+la sogs lnga la byin rlabs dang srung ba sbyin dgos zhes pa ltar mdzad/ do ha dang dbu ma bar do gsum gcig gyi mgur mdzad/ bal po'i nang pa'i paṇ+ḍita bā su de ba dang*/ de'i bu ma ṇi rat+na la bde dgyes sogs la legs sbyar gyi gsung*/ 'phros mdzad pas shin tu dad par gyur/ bal po rgyal pos zhabs skyel mdzad/ slar bya rung kha shor la phyag mchod sogs mdzad/ bal po'i rgyal blon 'bangs bcas kyi re ba thams cad bskangs te bla ma spyan 'dren gyi la nas phebs/ maṅgar gyi rngon pa zhig gis mda' gzhu phul nas sdig pa spangs pa'i dam bca' phul/ de nas yol mo gangs rar phebs pa'i dpal tshogs dang sgang yol du phebs/ rgod tshang gling du brgyad mchod bde mchog gi chog mdzad/ rdo rje gling du phebs gsung mgur gnang*/ yang dag mchog gi sgrub phug tu phebs bla ma gsang 'dus kyi las byang btang ba dang*/ gsol 'debs rang bzhin lhun rdzogs ma thugs brtsam mdzad/ mdo kha mchod rten zhes pa'i gter gnas der phebs lha bsangs gnang*/ dzo 'dril dgon du phebs bla ma ngag dpal bzang gis sbyin bdag zhus nas dus mchod rgyas par byas/ yul der ri rgya klung rgya bsdams dge bcu'i khrims bcas/ za hor rgyal po'i dbu thod sogs nang rten rnams mjal/

stag phug seṅge rdzong du phebs/ rje mi la'i zhabs rjes dang rje btsun stag la sprul pa'i stag gi rjes sogs mjal/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i drung nas tshogs 'khor 'bul mi 'byor/ o rgyan gyi sbas yul skye ba lung du phebs/ lcags rta gsar bzhad kyi lo sar sogs mdzad/ yang la ko ṭar phebs tshogs 'khor mdzad/ khams 'grul rnams la phyag chen gyi khrid gnang*/ de nas rim par pheb brod phug tu cho 'phrul gyi smon lam sogs mdzad/ der 'dus rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid gnang*/ bdud 'dul phug tu phebs/ de nas g.yu lo bkod/ snyan g.yon/ mchong ling*/ shwa spud steng sogs brgyud de spro bde bkra shis sgang du phebs/ der rje rgyal ba'i dbang po chibs bsur phebs nas dwags po rin po ches rje btsun thog mar mjal ba'i pha bong steng du bzhugs pa la phyag dang mjal rten phul/ rgyal ba'i dbang por rgya bal gyi spyad cha mang po phul/ lhan rgyas chu dbar du phebs/ lcags rta dbo zla'i tshes bzhir glo bur du sku bsnyun par karma pa nas sgar dang chos sde rnams su sku rim rgya cher bsgrubs/ zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba phur tshug tu 'debs pa gnang bas res snyun dngas pa dang res bsnyun pa'i rnam pa du ma byung mthar/ rta lo tha skar can gyi nyer brgyad kyi sngo dror dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs/ sku gdung rin po che mtshur phur spyan drangs/ karma chags med zhabs kyis phyag sor sgron mer phul nas gsol ba btab pas snying po'i don gyi ye shes brnyes/ bod yul gyi chos sde mtha' dag la dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul rgya chen bsgrub par mdzad/ rje grags seng ba dang mkha' spyod dbang po gnyis kas zhal chems su sku gdung ril por mchod rten dkar po skya sang nge ba zhig gi nang du zhog gsungs pa ltar zhwa dmar ba na rim rnams kyi sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa'i gtan tshig gis sku gdung rin po che dngul ljang brdung gi lha babs mchod rten rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhal bkod ltar bzhengs pa'i bum par bzhugs shing gzhan yang ring bsrel rnam pa lngas phyur bur bkangs shing rgyal ba'i dbang po nas rab tu gnas par mdzad nas lha dang bcas pa'i mchod sdong dam pa 'di grub pa'o//

zhwa dmar drug pa'i rnam thar 'di yang 'jam dbyangs karma mtshan legs kyis mdzad pa'i rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i char sprin dang*/ bal yul du phebs pa'i lam yig dang*/ gzhan rnam thar nor bu'i phreng ba zhes pa'i zin bris rgyas pa zhig 'dug pa las bsdus te bkod pa'o// rgyal ba 'di'i thugs sras kyi gtso bo ni karma pa chos dbyings mchog gi rdo rje/ go shrī lnga pa dpal ldan grags pa mchog dbyangs/ tā'i si tu rin po che chos kyi rgyal mtshan dge legs dpal bzang po/ sgam po sprul sku karma mi pham rnam rgyal/ ri bo che'i sku skye karma grags pa rnam rgyal rnams dang*/ rgod tshang sku skye karma grub mchog /mkha' reg sku skye karma bstan srung*/ tsher lung pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ gar dbang karma bstan skyong*/ tre chung sku skye karma bstan 'dzin dar rgyas/ yol mo ba sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/ dhi tsha sku skye karma 'jig rten dbang phyug /'chi med sprul sku 'chi med ngag dbang*/ zur mang dkon mchog bstan 'dzin sogs don brgyud kyi sprul sku rnams dang*/ byang bdag po bla ma sku mched/ rtse lha sgang gdung brgyud karma bkra shis/ 'bri khung gcung dkon mchog sku mched/ phag gru'i gdung brgyud karma brtson 'grus pa/ shes rab phun tshogs/ rkyen dbon karma blo ldan/ ri bo che'i chos rje grags pa rnam rgyal/ spungs ri drung pa karma sgrub brgyud bstan 'dzin/ mnga' ris lha btsun karma rnam rgyal/ rin spungs chos mdzad mched gnyis/ gtsang pa karma tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ spel chung ba dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ go shrī karma chos rgyal sogs che btsun gyi slob ma rnams dang*/ slob dpon smra seng*/ legs gling mkhan po karma thub bstan/ ba le rab 'byams pa mkhyen brtse/ dwags gling pa don gnyis lhun grub/ gangs ra lo chen karma dgra bcom pa/ gnas nang karma don grub/ rtsi shag bla ma mngon dga'/

lo tsā ba brtan pa/ bram ze paṇ+ḍita da mo da/ paṇ+ḍita ma dhu/ pho brang pa karma 'jigs med/ e pa dpal grub/ g.yam bzang mkhan po/ karma mi pham/ dwags po mchod sprin/ mi nyag pa bkra shis dar rgyas/ 'tsho byed sman mo che ba/ chu shul ba karma mtshan legs/ nyin gling karma sa skyong sogs mkhas pa'i slob ma rnams dang*/ mkhas shing grub pa'i slob ma'i tshogs ni/ gnas mdo karma chags med/ drung yig blo gros nor ldan/ zhig chen karma lhun grub/ bya btang bstan pa rnam rgyal/ za phu ba yid bzhin dbang rgyal sogs dang*/ gzhan yang drung pa dad grol/ ka bzhi bya btang*/ kaṃ po bam steng bla ma/ sog po byang chub/ drung pa bde mchog /cog gra ba karma gsang ba/ byen le chos 'phel/ ne ring pa rnam rgyal tshangs pa/ rgya gar lho phyogs pa shi ba shaṃ ka ra/ rdza ra ba rin chen dpal 'byor/ rgya bya rtogs ldan dad 'phel/ chu dbar ba bdud rtsi dang gzhan phan sogs rtogs ldan gyi slob ma rnams dang*/ sbyin bdag dang slob ma thun mong pa rnams ni/ sa tham rgyal po karma mi pham tshe dbang rab brtan/ sde srid karma bstan skyong dbang po/ rgya ston go shrī/ gangs dkar ba mi dbang khu dbon/ 'brang bu go shrī/ chos mdzad chos bkra shis/ snar thang sde pa don 'grub/ tshangs sar kwan ting go shrī/ yar stod pa karma mi pham bsod nams rab brtan/ rgyal ri ba karma chos rgyal/ nang chen go shrī/ ye rang rgyal po sid+dhin ra siṃha/ ri bo che'i sde pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ thu med tha'i ji karma tshe ring sogs rnams so//

༈¿¿rje karma kun dga' rnam rgyal ni/ zur mang rtsi rong nyin dgon du/ yab a gro gcod pa sangs rgyas bkra shis dang*/ yum rje btsun sgrol gyi sras su shing yos la sku 'khrungs/ ma'i khong nas yig drug dang gsung mang du byon/ sku 'khrungs nas gom pas 'byon pa dang gar mdzad/ nga kun dga' 'od zer gyi skye ba yin zhes dang*/ lkog gyur mang po gsungs/ drung pa legs bshad pas bdag rkyen dang*/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen mdzad mtshan karma kun dga' rnam rgyal du btags/ dbu ma lugs kyi byang sdom gnang*/ rgyal sras blo gros rnam rgyal drung nas rang gling dang zur mang snyan brgyud skor rnams gsan/ dgung lo bco lngar mtshur phur phebs/ zhwa dmar lnga pa'i drung nas rab byung mdzad/ mtshan snga ma de la dpal bzang po zhes bsnan/ dgung lo bcu gsum la phyag chen gyi khrid gnang*/ rtsa gsum dril sgrub dang mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang stsal/ rje dgu pa las phyag chen chos drug sogs dbang khrid mang po zhus/ rje dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mtsho las/ nang brtag rgyud gsum sogs zhus/ dgung lo bcu bdun la khams su phebs/ sangs rgyas rin chen nas zur mang lugs kyi dbang khrid thams cad zhus nas bdud rtsi dil du dam bca' bcu gsum mdzad nas nyams len kho na gnang*/ tshad mdo mngon pa gong 'og /dbu ma rtsa 'jug /spyod 'jug / mdo rtsa sogs bslabs/ dgung lo nyer lngar rje dgu pa gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs rgya chen bsgrubs/ wer phug tu skyil krung gcig gi steng du lo drug la bzhugs/ brag chu rdol yang ma bzhengs/ nyin re bzhes tsha lan gnyis re las ma bzhes/ de nas zur mang du phebs te tshogs par phyag chen gyi khrid gnang*/ gcod kyi nyams len dang*/ snyan brgyud sgor gyi zin bris 'ga' re mdzad/ rje karma bstan skyong la zur mang lugs kyi dbang khrid lung rnams gnang*/ slar wer phug du sngar mus ltar bzhugs/ zhwa dmar drug pa zur mang du phebs par gsung shog gnang nas zur mang du mjal bar phebs/

dgung lo zhe bzhi la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ dgyes rdor drung mdzad pa dang*/ phyag bzhi pa'i dbang sogs zhus/ dgung lo zhe dgu par gzi phor dbeng du gcod kyi bslangs tshad sku pang du thog lhung ba gzan mthur btums pa sogs gnyan sa brgya dang brgyad du phebs/ kris mo nor rdzu 'phrul gyis skad cig la gcod tho brgya brtsegs/ bdud rtsi dil du rje chos dbyings rdo rje mjal gser zho sum brgya sogs phul/ zhwa dmar drug pa'i bkas grwa rgyun bsdu phyir 'bri rgyud du phebs phyag chen gyi khrid mang po gnang tsher lung du phug pa la zang thal sogs mdzad/ g.yu gshis su phebs/ dwa bdud rong gsum/ lha 'brong ber gsum gyi grwa rgyun mang po 'dus/ bsdus ra nas bzung gzhung lugs kun bslab/ slob dpon du dge the dka' bcu ba bskos/ gying thang*/ karma/ yol mig rnams su phyag chen sogs kyi khrid btsugs mel phug du dud sol ma zhal gzigs/ zhwa dmar drug pa dang g.yu gshis su mjal/ grwa rgyun rnams phul/ bdud rtsi dil dang zur mang du spyan drangs/ sku rim mdos chen dang*/ tshogs chen bshams gar gzigs phul/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang sogs dbang khrid mang po zhus/ de nas sgar chen ri bo cher pheb skabs su der phebs/ rje zhwa dmar par bka' chos kyi thog mar phyag bzhi pa'i rgyud chung rnams kyi lung phul/ chos sgor lung rig nyi mas thog mar mjal/ de nas dbus su byon dgung lo nga gcig par za dam du phebs/ che tshang dang chos sgo bar zur lugs kyi dbang khrid rnams stsal/ gar dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du dbang lung gi 'phros rnams phul/ mdos chen brgyad cu sogs bcas/ rje nyid gcig pur yer pa'i bsam gtan phug gong mar bzhugs/ grwa phyir bla ma nyi zla grags pa las zhi byed skor rnams zhus/ zhwa dmar drung du ne gu chos drug dang zhi byed skor yab bka' dang yum bka'i dbang sogs phul/

stag lung ngag dbang rnam rgyal las sgyu lus dbang mo che sogs gsan/ phar la bkra shis dpal grub dang khu dbon la mgon po bka' rgyas kyi dbang sogs gnang*/ rtse thang zhabs drung bsod nams lhun po las lam 'bras lam skor bcas/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan las ber gyi dbang sogs mang du zhus/ zhwa dmar drung du lam 'bras skor sogs thugs thog nas phul kha reg sprul sku/ e pa drung yig pa sogs dbus gtsang gi bla chen mi chen mang por dbang khrid lung sogs stsal/ zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzim gur du rje 'di khri 'don dang phyag 'bul dang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ dbon po nam mkha' la'ang chos 'brel bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsan/ rta khal sogs phul ba ni ma bzhes/ de nas lha sar phebs jo shāka rnam gnyis la gser chab sogs phul/ bsam yas dang 'bri khung dang stag lung za dam rnams su phyi phyag la phebs/ ri bo cher chos rje grags pa rgyal mtshan la pad gling gi tshe dbang sogs gsan/ phar la gcod khrid sogs gnang zla phyed tsam bzhugs/ re ne dgon dang karma dang*/ zur mang du phebs/ gyam ger mdzod dge bsnyen mdzad/ gar dbang bstan skyong dang che tshang 'gyur med snying po sogs la phyag chen gyi smin khrid gnang*/ rje nyid rmo dang gtsug phur phebs te sgrub sde'i spyil bu sogs mdzad/ dbus gtsang su yab sras sogs la 'bul mo che bskur/ gnas mdo karma chags med dang khams smyon sogs la phyag chen khrid gnang*/ bdud rtsi dil gyi lha khang zhig gso mdzad/ be ri don yod kyis go chos khri thang du spyan drangs 'bul chen phul/ gtsug phur phebs sgrub sde dang rad gling thugs rje chen po gsang 'dus kyi bum sgrub btsugs/ sa 'brug mchu zla'i tshes bcu bzhi la mya ngan las 'das so// rje 'di ni dge slong gi bslab bya sha chang dang dgongs lto mi bzhes rta khal mi chibs/ dngos rdzas mi 'dzin pa'i bya btang gi brtul zhugs kho na mdzad/

phyag phreng dang phyag dpe nam mkhar 'jog pa dang*/ rlung chen po'i nang du phyag dpe'i shog 'dabs rlung gis bsgul mi nus pa sogs tshur mthong gi ngor yang ston par mdzad/ lha dang mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i gzigs snang ni 'byams su klas so// slob ma yang rje gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug /stag lung ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ sa skya rgyan rin po che/ karma bstan skyong*/ 'gyur med snying po/ kha reg sprul sku/ rgod phug sprul sku/ drung yig blo gros nor ldan/ gnas mdo karma chags med/ chos sgo ba lung rig nyi ma sogs mkhas grub kyi skyes bu dam pa du ma byon no// ༈¿¿go shrī grags pa mchog dbyangs ni/ gdung rus/ rmu tsha sga/ gtsang gi gting skyes mkhar chen du/ yab mi dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ yum rigs ldan dbang mo'i sras su me 'brug mgo zla'i tshes brgyad nyin pho brang bsam 'grub rtser lhums su zhugs/ me sbrul dbyug zla'i rgyal ba gnyis par sku bltams/ mtshan 'jam dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug tu gsol/ /jo nang rje btsun gyi chos byas na bshes gnyen dam pa zhig 'ong zhes lung bstan/ rje gong ma'i spos 'dzin pa karma yang dag sleb pa na ngo mkhyen te khang steng nas karma yang dag dbang zhus shig gsungs pas/ the tshom thams cad chod/ rje tā ra nā tha las dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dbang dang*/ rang nyid kyi thugs brtsam sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi dbang bskur kun legs par zhus/ de la rje'i zhal nas deng sang gi skye bo rnams rmongs zhen ches bas chos mdzad 'di lta bu don du mi gnyer bar ma zad bsting tshig kho na spro par byed kyin 'dug ces gsungs so zhes pa'ang 'dug/ de nas mdzod pa karma don dam dang zur ri bla ma bde mchog gtsang sde srid kyi gser yig pa sogs 'byor/ de rnams kyis da bar sprul pa'i sku mi phebs pa ci yin zhus pas/

chos bkras sogs bar srid kyi 'gro don ches mang du bsgrubs pas 'gor ces gsungs/ si tu+u chos kyi rgyal mtshan chibs bsur phebs nas sba nam du zhwa dmar pa'i sgar du spyan drangs te zhal 'dzom gnang*/ zhwa dmar sku zhabs nas/ kun khyab mkha' la rgya chad phyogs lhung bral sogs kyi brtan bzhugs dang rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi tshe dbang mdzad/ dgung lo brgyad la mos ston tshon po'i gdung rigs sa skyong thob rgyal bas spyan drangs bsnyen bskur mdzad/ de nas rgyal mkhar rtse'i klu sdings su sgar phab/ rgyal ba chos dbyings rdo rje phebs pa mjal/ thog mar bka' brgyud gser phreng dang mdo sde pad dkar gyi lung stsal/ shing byi'i lo sar dang smon lam mdzad/ gtsang sde srid kyis spyan drangs nas dga' ba gdong du phebs/ yab sras lhan rgyas rnams kyis rang rtags kyi cod pan dang rje 'dis dmar ser gyi cod pan thog mar gsol/ mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshos mdun bster/ khyad par du mi'i bdag pos 'byor ba rgya mtshos mchod par byas/ snron zla'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang tshogs 'khor mdzad/ karma pa dang rgyal tshab si tu bcas jo mo gangs su phebs/ slob dpon sgrub phug dkar leb dang*/ rang byung ba'i sgrub gnas mtshal zhal du phebs/ der yab sras so so'i zhabs rjes re byon/ gnam ru bkra shis kyis 'bul chen bstabs/ pha bong be'u g.yag tu yang yab sras sa so'i zhabs rjes re'ang byon/ de nas mtshur phur phebs/ rje dpa' bo dang*/ zhwa dmar sku zhabs bcas rgyal ba lnga zhal 'dzom mdzad/ rten gan+dho la'i drung du gar gyi dbang po nas rje karma pa bsnyen rdzogs dang karma'i drung nas rje 'di nyid yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen mdzad/ gtsug phud dor/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang stsal bar mdzad/ rdo rje 'dzin mchog thugs rje'i gzi byin gyis sogs zhabs brtan smon lam gnang*/ zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung nas rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa gnang*/

mtshan dpal ldan grags pa mchog dbyangs 'gro ba'i khyu mchog kun tu bzang po'i rnam par rol pa'i dpal zhes gsol/ gar dbang mchog gi drung nas bka' 'gyur gyi lung stsal ba'i dbu tshugs pa dang*/ mi bskyod zhabs kyi dgongs gcig 'grel pa'i ljags bshad gnang*/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i drung nas thugs dam lnga tshan lngas thog drang gsar rnying gi dbang lung man ngag gi mdzod sgo phye bar mdzad/ rin po che smra seng klog pa'i slob dpon du bsten te bsdus grwa nas brtsam gsung rab rgya mtshor bslab sbyong mdzad/ dgu gtor dang smon lam la phebs/ si tu sprul sku dang lhan cig rdo rje kun grags ma'i bsti gnas su phebs/ o rgyan sgrub phug tu rdzogs chen nyams bzhes mdzad/ de nas gar gyi dbang po bde chen yangs pa can du phebs par rje nyid kyang yangs can du chibs kha bsgyur nas lho rtser bzhugs/ zhing skyong gi 'tshams gzigs dang*/ byams pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs can gyi gos sku mjal/ shing glang nag nyar rje gar gyi dbang po nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khoragyi dbang*/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa rdul tshon la brten nas stsal/ skabs der rje 'di sa skyong thob rgyal bas spyan drangs yum gyi yum sogs smin grol gyi bdud rtsis tshims par mdzad/ de nas lho brag sras mkhar du phebs rje gtsug lag rgya mtshos bsnyen bskur rgya cher gnang*/ rdo rje phreng ba bla med kho na'i lugs dkyil 'khor nyer brgyad dang*/ mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang bskur bstsal/ mi tri'i dbang drug dang khrid drug dang*/ rjog dkyil bdun gyi dbang dang*/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang*/ sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis gtum po lha lnga/ phag mo lha lnga/ sgrol dkar rjes gnang*/ mtshur lugs dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs rdzogs/ ba ri seng gdong*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu lnga'i dbang*/

'jigs mdzad bcu gsum ma/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ rta nag dregs pa yong sgrol/ dpa' bo lha bzhi/ bde mchog nag po lugs/ tshe dpag lha dgu/ tshe sgrub rin chen nyi 'od/ skyer rta/ tshe dpag grub rgyal ma/ ma mgon 'khor lnga'i rjes gnang*/ phyag bzhi pa'i bum dbang bcu bzhi dang*/ tsho ring ma dang*/ phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang*/ dud sol ma'i gtor dbang sogs dang*/ dus mkhyen bka' 'bum dang*/ sems 'grel skor gsum/ theg bsdus/ dbu ma rig tshogs/ rgyud 'bum dang phar chen gyi lung sogs zhus/ rje dpa' bo nas/ mnyams med shākya'i bstan pa rin chen 'dir sogs kyi zhabs brtan bka' brtsam gnang*/ sras mkhar/ gro bo lung*/ gnya' gnya'/ 'gar tshang sogs kyi gnas gzigs mdzad/ der zhabs rjes zhig kyang byon/ zhwa dmar nag phebs nas lhan rgyas dbang lung sogs phan tshun bstab res mdzad/ de nas yab sras gsum po yar 'brog g.yu mtshor pheb pa dang rim par dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod du phebs/ rten rnams gzigs/ dpal gyi bsam yas su phebs/ dbu rtse rim gsum sogs lha khang thams cad mjal/ sems bskyed gling du zhwa dmar sku zhabs nas rgyal ba mchog dang lhan cig dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed gnang*/ pe har lcog tu phebs/ pe har sku phebs pas sum skas las lag pa dar lcibs bcas/ rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku'i phyag nas 'then pa'i zhabs phyi byed pa na rje nyid dgyes pa'i nyams kyis phyag brkyang par mdzad/ snye thang 'od du phebs/ jo bo chen po'i mchod sdong dang*/ gsol lhung*/ gsil byed/ sku 'bum rnams mjal/ gar gyi dbang po nas jo bo'i sku 'dra'i mdun du thogs med lugs kyi sems bskyed gnang ba dpal karma pa dang lhan cig tu'o/ /mdo sdud pa'i ljags lung kyang stsal/ lhan rgyas mtshur phur phebs lo mjug bskang gso dang sa 'brug lo sar gnang*/ za dam du phebs/ rje 'di gzim chung karma lha khang du bzhugs/

zhwa dmar sku zhabs nas gsol ston sogs yang yang stsal/ rgyal ba'i dbang po dang go shrī'i dbu zhwa bsgron/ tshogs 'khor sogs dang 'bul chen bstabs/ rje zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid dang*/ rgyal tshab grags pa don grub kyis mdzad pa'i lam sgron rnam bshad kyi steng nas skyes bu gsum gyi khrid gnang*/ bya bzang brag sogs 'phan yul skor gyi gnas gzigs mdzad nas byang stag lung du phebs rje 'di hor khang du bzhugs/ 'jag spyil rin po che/ sing gling bra ga skya rdor rdzongs/ gtsug lag khang gsar rnying sku 'bum sogs mjal/ 'dus sder rgyal tshab nas lam sgron gyi khrid gnang*/ pu to ba/ sha ra ba/ sne zur pa sogs kyi sgrub gnas rnams mjal/ yer pa lha ri snying por phebs rten brten pa rnams zhib par mjal te/ za dam dang mtshur phu brgyud/ gtsang sde srid kyis spyan drangs te yangs can nas stag gru rin chen spungs pa dang 'og min gling du phebs/ karma bstan skyong dbang pos chibs bsu bcas rgyal ba rnam gsum rgyal mkhar rtser phebs/ lo mjug bskang gso dang*/ sa sprul lo gsar dang smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur phebs/ gar gyi dbang po nas der 'dus rnams la 'bri khung dgongs gcig rje brgyad pa'i bzhed pa ltar dang*/ zab mo nang don gyi ljags bshad stsal/ spong ba pa'i sde rnams la thun bzhi'i khrid stsal ba sogs gsan/ sa skyong dam pa nas rigs ldan yol ba bkram nas gar 'chams sogs spyan gzigs 'bul zhabs rgya cher mdzad/ zhwa dmar sku zhabs nas sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang tshar gcig zhus/ yab sras gnyis rgya tsho pas spyan drangs/

de nas rim par stod phyogs su phebs par chibs skyel zhus te rgyal mkhar rtser phebs/ tha skar can gyi tshes brgyad la 'od zer gling gi 'dus sde 'dzugs par mdzad/ legs bshad gling nas bka' bcu chos dar/ nyin gling nas bka' bcu ye shes sogs bzhi sde/ 'og min gling nas bka' bcu 'dren mchog /'dul grwa gling nas bka' bcu snying po sogs bcu phrag gsum bsgrigs nas rin po che smra seng chos 'chad pa por bsko bar mdzad/ lcags rta lor gar dbang drug pa sku bsnyun pa thos nas/ sku rim rgya chen bsgrubs/ rgyal ba rnams kyi rigs kyi bdag po mchog /zhes sogs kyi brtan bzhugs phul gtsang pas spyan drangs te sba nam du phebs/ bsnyen bskur zhus/ hor gnam ru ba sogs kyis 'bul chen spungs/ nyid kyi klog pa'i slob dpon sku yol ba'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrubs/ rgyal ba rnam gnyis drung du zhu yig dang sku'i nyer spyad chibs pa zung re sogs bskur nas/ gar dbang thams cad mkhyen pa tha ma'i mdzad pa la phyogs pa mkhyen te phyogs der chibs bskyod gnang*/ rje dpa' bo rin po che yang mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i pho nya bsleb 'phral/ dus gsum sras bcas rgyal ba ma lus pa'i sogs gsol 'debs gnang*/ chu dbar du phebs lam zhig tu phyag rjes zhig kyang byon/ chu mig dngul 'bum nas mchod zhal gyis bcus pa 'o ma'i mdog tu gyur/ rje chos kyi dbang phyug tha skar can gyi tshes bcu gsum la zhi bar gzims nas brin du rgyal ba'i dbang po dang mjal/ sku gdung rin po che la phyag mchod bgyis/ sman lung gi gnas gzigs gnang*/ rgyal ba'i dbang pos sku gdung snga sor spyan drangs te phebs/ rje 'dis sgar chen gyi dbu 'dren mdzad de phyi nas phebs/ dam pa sangs rgyas kyi gnas ding ri glang 'khor dang*/ brag rgod tshang can dang*/ dpal ldan sa skya rnams mjal/ rma byar yab gting skyes sde srid kyis mjal/

sa dbang dam pas kyang bsnyen bskur tshad med zhus/ de nas mtshur phur kar sde kun 'dus pa'i gdung mchod kyi tshogs dbur phebs/ rje 'dis kyang ris med kyi chos sde rnams su mchod 'bul rgya cher mdzad/ skabs der rgyal ba'i dbang por zhabs brtan dngos rdzas dang bgrang yas bskal pa'i sngon nas 'gro ba kun sogs phul/ lo mjug gi dus rim dang*/ lcags lug lo sar smon lam gyi 'dren par phebs/ legs bshad gling gi rab 'byams pa karma lha mchog zhes pa klog pa'i slob dpon du bsten/ thugs 'dzin/ ljags skyor/ bgro gleng rnams nyin ltar du dpyis phyin par mdzad/ smra seng gi skabs bsdus tshan rnams dang*/ kā ri kā lnga bcu pa/ lam sgron/ byams chos sde lnga/ 'jug pa/ rnam 'grel/ mdzod/ nang don rnams thugs su chud nas/ lha mdongs lo chen gyi dbon blo gros mchog ldan nas/ lany war dang*/ sgra rgyud nyung*/ snyan ngag me long ma rnams gsan/ dus 'dir/ rnam 'grel la rtsa slob mdzad/ de yang chos grags rgya mtsho'i rig gzhung rgya mtsho ltar dang*/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i 'grel pa nyi dkyil dang*/ rje brgyad pa'i mngon ṭīka dang mngon rgyan ṭīk rje btsun ngal bso/ 'jug 'grel grub shing rnams gsan/ bar skabs rnams su bka' ram rnams dang 'bel mchid du mas sbyang brdar mdzad/ rtogs ldan blo gros nor ldan las bka' 'gyur gyi lung 'phros dang*/ thar rgyan/ go shrī gong mas mdzad pa'i phyag chen khrid yig dang*/ blo sbyong gi gzhung yig rnying rnams kyi lung gsan/ nyin ltar gyi thugs dam 'grig chags rnams dang*/ zla dus kyi tshes mchod kyi rigs rnams chag med gnang*/ skabs der 'chi med pho brang gi zhal ba'i ngos su zhabs rjes zhig byon/ nam chi ja'i sang dang sog po karma dag gis mchod par byas/ zhwa dmar pa'i dngul gdung lha khang bzhengs pa'i rdo ba nyin re lan lnga drug re sku rgyab tu drangs par mdzad/

chu sprel smon lam sogs grub nas/ rje bcu pa nas sgrol dkar rjes gnang dang*/ rtsa gsum dril sgrub tshe dbang brgya rtsa gnang*/ rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po dang mjal/ nang chen karma rab brtan/ rin spungs pa'i lha btsun/ zur mang gar dbang bstan skyong pa/ che tshang bsod nams 'gyur med sogs dbang chos kyis tshims par mdzad/ 'dzam gling yongs grags zhes pa su dang gang la'ang mi mgu pas des kyang mkhas mthong gi bsngags pa brjod/ sne'u gdong rtser chu 'khyags kyi rngog ma ba ru ra tsam bab pa na sdigs mdzub gtad pa'i mod la zhi bar gyur/ gong ma chos kyi rgyal pos lhag par gus pas mchod/ thar pa gling dang yar stod karma lha khang du pheb tshe/ gzhung lugs gling pas bgro gleng gi mchod pa phul/ shel brag dang tshe chu 'bum pa mjal/ tshal min du phebs skabs zab skur phyag nas zug /mtshur phur phebs skabs bya btang bstan pa rnam rgyal dang grub dbang karma nor bus yang yang mjal/ yab rgyal po gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs rnams bsgrubs nas skabs 'dir si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan rje dgu pas lung bstan pa ltar gur khyim zhes par sku thim par gyur/ lho brag tu gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i gdung rten la phyag nas gnang skabs nas 'bru zug/sna dkar rtser spyan drangs/ der sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung la bar skabs 'phel rgyun chad par khrus gsol ba'i mod la mang du 'phel zhing de phyin nas 'phel ba'i rgyun tshugs/ mtshur phur phebs nas si tu rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul bsgrubs pa dang gar dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngul gdung la lhan rgyas nas rab gnas mdzad/ 'bri gung chos rje ngag dbang rin chen dpal grub phebs pas mjal/ khyung rdzong dang dbang phyug phug tu bcad rgya mdzad/ yum 'da' ka ma'i dbang bskur dang 'pho 'debs byang bzhu sogs mdzad/ skabs de rnams su phyogs kyi mjal 'bul sogs sprin ltar 'thib/

sog yul du song ba'i bla ma rnams kyis 'bul chen bstabs/ khar kha'i rgyal po ar sa lags kyi dpung chen lhags par rgyal ba mchog gi bka' ltar zul phur phebs te de dang chog thu'i 'bul skyel ba sogs la mjal kha gnang*/ sog dmag yar 'brog tu bab pas/ sde pa gtsang pas zhus ngor dmag dpung de rnams phyir bzlog par mdzad/ yangs can 'dus sder slo sbyong khrid dang*/ brgyad cu skor la yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen stsal/ 'brum nad mched par yangs pa'i grong khyer la 'jug pa nyin ltar gsungs pas rgyun chad/ bla sman pa mang ra nas sbyar spos kyi bam po phul bas thugs dgyes pa mthong nas/ kho pas 'di 'dra karma par phul na'ang ci ma rung bsam pa mkhyen nas khyod kyi yin byas nas bdag gis 'bul chog gsungs pas khong rang ha las par gyur/ mdzod pa 'das pa'i skye ba gar 'ong zhus pas/ rang dbang du 'du ba zhig yong zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mchod gzhis bkra shis gshongs zhes par byung ba ngos 'dzin mdzad nas 'od zer gling du slob gnyer la sbyar/ sde pa pho brang ba karma 'jigs med phyag mdzod du bskos/ kha reg sku skye rnam gnyis la 'dod chos sogs gnang*/ grub brnyes drung yig pa blo gros nor ldan las dbang chos ci rigs pa zhig gsan/ chu bo rir phebs/ bla ma rdzogs chen pas rang gi dgon gnas sogs phul/ nyin ltar du gnas la zhabs skor gnang*/ der zhabs rjes zhig kyang byon/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i spyil bur zhal ba'i ngos su phyag zhabs bzhi'i rjes byon/ ri bo che'i chos rje grags pa rgyal mtshan phebs pas mjal sgrol dkar rjes gnang sogs stsal/ jo bo'i sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang dang*/ tshur la phyag bzhi pa'i bum dbang bcu bzhi sogs gsan par mdzad/ tshe chu sgrub sde pa sogs la phyag chen gyi khrid mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po'i rgyab sha can dang chos drug gi khrid stsal/ kha reg sprul sku bstan srung pas spyan drangs te kha reg tu phebs/

rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams gzigs tshogs 'khor mdzad/ sde pa brag kha pa'i rjes sgrub la phebs sde pa gzhung dang dpon sa nas 'bul chen bstabs/ gdan sa thel dang*/ zangs ri mkhar dmar dang bsam yas rnams su phebs/ ras chung sbug nas rgod tshang sprul pa'i sku dang*/ karma bka' brgyud sgron me bcas mjal bar phebs/ gzhung sbre zhing du phebs/ mar pa'i gdung 'bum dang rje mi la'i sgrub phug mjal/ zangs ri dpon sa'i rjes sgrub la spyan drangs par phebs de nas lha yul gyi la mor bzhugs skabs zhib chang gi dbus su phyag rjes byon pa drung ram tshogs gnyis kyis bka' bcu 'byung nas kyi bya btang rin po che'i dngul gdung gi nang rten la 'bul snyam pa shar ba de mkhyen nas/ khyod rang gi de dang de lta bu sems so zhes rgyang ring du bskyur par/ slar btsal nas rnyed/ der zhabs 'dred ltar mdzad nas zhabs zung gi rjes rdo bar byon pa da lta mtshur phur yod/ bzed gzhis kar rgyal ba'i dbang po mjal nas zhabs brtan gnad 'gro phul ba dang*/ rje nyid 'gog snyoms la bzhugs pa rgyal ba mchog gis rgyud mang gi sgras bskul bar mdzad/ rje karma pa chen po jo shāka la zhabs skor du phebs pa'i lam khar 'jang rgyal po'i 'bul skyel ba rnams kyis mjal/ dbu zhwa gnyis bsgron/ lha ldan du phebs gnas rten rnams mjal/ rje dbon nam mkha' 'da' karma'i dbang dang sku gshegs tshe lam ston sogs mdzad/ lhan rgyas gnas nang du phebs rje dbon gyi rjes sgrub mdzad/ mtshur phu dang gzed gzhis kar phebs/ de tshe byang phyogs nas o rod bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi dpung chen bsam 'grub rtser theg /rgyal ba mchog brgyad grwar bzhugs/ rje gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i sprul sku sde pa lha yul pa'i zhal ngor 'khrungs pa spyan drangs te lho brag tu phebs/ rje 'di nyid karma pa'i sgar du spyan drangs nas karma pa nyid kyi chibs kha ba mdzad/

yab sras bka' bgros te kong dmag rnams phyir bzlog par mdzad/ rje nyid gangs dkar rdo rje gdan du phebs der gnas kyi skye 'gro rnams g.yul ngor 'chi ba'i duḥkha las bskyabs/ de nas gzhis ka rtser phebs/ rgyal po chen po mchod yon lhan cig tu rje 'di'i zhabs la gus pas btud/ karma pa chen po yang phebs te dus kyi 'khrugs pa de zhi ba'i bka' stsal yang sngon gyi las la bya thabs bral/ yab sras lhan cig dga' gdong nas rong chen brgyud legs bshad gling du phebs rim par lho brag tu phebs rje 'dis dpa' bo sprul skur dbang lung sogs stsal/ 'dus sder phyag chen dang chos drug gi khrid stsal de phyogs kyi gnas rten rnams mjal/ rgyal ba'i dbang po nas mkhan po mdzad de grangs tshang ba'i dge 'dun gyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ dngul srang nyis brgya las rje rgyal ba'i dbang pos phyag blugs mdzad pa'i sgrol ma'i sku zhig gnang*/ de nas gar dge'i nang khul gyi don du rgyal tshab dam pa gtsang phyogs su chibs bsgyod de srin lag zhes par phebs pa na rje ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub yang der phebs/ rgyal tshab rin po che 'di sku thor bzhes pas karma pa nas phyag rdor gyi sku khyad par can phyag blugs zhig stsal/ bkra shis dpal grub nas rje nyid kyis thugs bzhed ltar rnam 'joms bya bas khrus dang*/ tshe dpag dkar po yang gsang lhan skyes dang*/ tshe dpag med sprul sku dang*/ grub rgyal ma yongs grags bcas kyi dbang brgya/ rje sdig lung ba'i lugs kyi sun bzlog dang sbrel ba'i zhabs brtan phul/ phyag bzhi pa dang legs ldan gyi gtor zlog bcas/ sku srung bsnyun g.yog thams cad zhabs drung rang nas zhus/ de nas gzhis ka rtser phebs te sa'i tshangs par drang po'i zhu gsol phul/ bkra shis lhun por paṇa chen rin po che mjal zhing legs tshogs su gyur shang rnam gling du gzhi 'jags bzhugs/

stag lung zhabs drung la/ snying rje pad dkar dang*/ rgya rol/ 'dzang blun/ skal bzang/ dus mkhyen bka' 'bum/ mi bskyod rje'i khrid thung pu sti/ sku gsum ngo sprod/ rlung sems dbyer med kyi bshad chen/ snying po gsang don/ rgan po'i rlung sman rnams kyi lung stsal/ stag lung zhabs drung nas chos dbang bla ma gsang 'dus kyi dbang chen/ zlum po bzhi dbang*/ byang gter drag mthing sogs kyi dbang bka' brgyad tsam dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ sdom 'byung*/ sbrang yon/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs dbang sna lnga bcu skor gsan par mdzad/ rgyal mkhar rtser phebs*/ gong nas mtshur phu sogs kam tshang gi chos sde nyer gcig tsam gnang zhing bod yul kyi kar sde kun gyi 'dren par mnga' gsol/ mtshur phu rtsis bzhes dang*/ chos sde so sor mi sna bkram pa sogs mdzad/ snye thang gi gnas gzigs gnang*/ gzhung sa nas thab bsu bcas lha sar phebs/ dkyil 'khor steng du mchod yon gyis mjal zhing bsnyen bkur rgya chen zhus/ de nas mi'i bdag po'i bkas kong por phebs/ rtse lha sgang dang*/ phrag su ru+u gdong sogs su 'khrugs pa rnams zhi bar mdzad/ rtse le sprul sku sogs la bka' chos dang*/ sgam po gdung brgyud dang chos rjer dbang lung sogs kyis rjes su bzung*/ sgam po pa'i thugs bzhed ltar rta phag gi gsol 'debs brtsam/ rat+na dang zhig gling 'ja' tshon pa rang gi gter lung nas chos bdag du lung bstan pa dus la babs par gzigs nas rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po sgar du spyan drangs/ thog mar gter ston rang gi thugs bzhed dbang chos sogs phul nas/ rta phag dang zhi khro nges snying dkon mchog spyi 'dus thugs dam mdzad/ slob dpon lha mchog gi bka' drin bsab pa'i phyir legs gling du dus ja dang*/ gtsug lag khang du ba dan bzang po zhig phul/ 'og min gling gi mchod gzhis rnams/ bzad dang sras mkhar sogs kyi chab mar 'od zer gling pa'i bsti gnas su thob/

legs bshad gling du slon dpon do bo ri pa karma blo mchog yangs can du stag tshang ngag dbang bkra shis 'god pa sogs kar sde thams cad rje 'di nyid kyis shes 'jug gi lung bzang thob/ legs gling tshogs mang la sgrol dkar dang phyag rdor dang*/ rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang stsal/ zla phyed gso sbyong btsugs/ rje nyid nas mdo don pa sogs gnang*/ dam pa 'dis bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu ma tshang bas gzhan la sdom pa 'bogs su mi rung phebs par/ rje bkra shis dpal grub nas gang zag spyir de ltar lags kyang*/ rje nyid ni 'dul ba la byang bas rung tshul zhus te de nas bzung don gnyer can rnams la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kho na gnang*/ gzhung mchod yon nas karma pa nyid mtshur phu'am tha na lho brag tsam du gdan chags pa dang*/ rgyal tshab rin po che 'di nyid kyis ji ltar mdzad pa ltar gnang na thugs dgyes pa'i mchod gnas su gsol ba 'debs pa'i gsung*/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i phyag dam gnang ba'i bka' shog gnang ba karma pa'i phyag tu rje bkra shis dpal grub kyis zhu nan bcas phul yang thugs ma gtad nas lho phyogs kā ma rū pa dang nye bar phebs song bas mi yi bdag po rnams thugs 'khrugs pas chos sde rnams la bka' bkyon chen po dang*/ stag lung zhabs drung la'ang gzigs pa 'jol bar gyur pa'i skabs/ rje 'di lha ldan du phebs nas yin lugs rnams snyan du zhus/ zhabs drung nas dbu bsnyung 'bul dgos byung 'dug/

rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po nas kyang karma pas mtha' dmag khrid par bshams zhes sogs gsungs 'dug mod karma pa dngos ni 'khrul zhig chen por 'dug pas de 'dra thugs la shar ba'i rigs su mi 'dug cing skabs de rnams su kar gtsang yon mchod kyi nang khul yang de tsam zhig med par mngon no/ /ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub la mi bskyod rje yi yig cha las bde mchog dkar po'i dbang bskur mdzad/ rdor dbyings dbang dang*/ chos chung brgya rtsa dpe chos rin spungs sogs kyi lung gsan/ nyin gling du drung ram smin grol yang rir karma rnam rgyal/ mtshur grwa tshang dang zur ri gnyis 'dzin du drung pa rin po che/ 'od zer gling du rab 'byams pa ye shes/ tshe chu sgrub sde dang*/ byang gling la kre bo chos rje rin po che rnams bskos/ rje nyid mtshur phur rtag bzhugs mdzad stag lung zhabs drung gis blun dad can rjes su bzung phyir gson byang zhig dgos zhes bskul nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg 'di mdzad/ me khyi lor g.yung dar rgyas gling du phebs gling gi nyams gso dang rab gnas mdzad pas nas 'bru rnams gos sku pha rir bkra ma par yang sgra dang bcas te phebs/ der bca' yig mdzad/ lam sgron dang*/ blo sbyong don bdun/ mtshon cha 'khor lo rnams dang*/ sman bla/ gdugs dkar/ seng gdong ma/ gos sngon can rnams kyi rjes gnang stsal/ gzhan 'gar phag mo'i dbang dang rje brgyad pa'i khrid thung pu sti'i lung mdzad/ gangs ra lo chen dang glang bu pa sogs la bzhed chos rnams gnang*/ gangs ra lo chen las gsan pa mang po mdzad/ mang por bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba dang zhwa zhal mang po bstan drung ram dar rgyas kyi sku skyer phyag chen khrid dang rjes gnang gcig shes kun grol sogs gnang*/ yangs can du phebs/ 'dus sder dam chos pad dkar dang*/ mtshan brjod/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje gtum po'i sgrub thabs/ spyi 'dus ljags lung*/

bde mchog rga lo lha lnga'i dbang*/ sgrol dkar rjes gnang*/ mi bskyod zhabs kyi zab rgyas snang ba sogs stsal/ rgyab rir lha bsangs btang*/ thang lha dngos su byung nas phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas/ mtshur phur phebs mchod gong rten gsum rnams la rab gnas gnang bas mkhar nag chu phar tshur du sil sgra dang bcas babs/ gong du spyi 'dus tshes bcu'i srol btsugs/ ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyis zhabs brtan phul/ yangs can sgom chen nyi ma sogs la rtsa gsum dril sgrub dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang dang*/ gsang lam bla sgrub kyi lung stsal/ zur mtshur sogs la phyag chen smin khrid dang ro snyom khrid sogs gnang nas cog mtshams kyi rgyun tshugs/ bde chen yang ri'i zhig gso dang*/ rang byung sku brnyan la nyams gso rab gnas mdzad pas sku 'dra las 'od 'phro ba byung der gnas de yi brtan ma g.yas mda' dar dang g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa gla ba la zhon pa'i gla ba'i sker dung dkar g.yas 'khyil btags pa zhig gis phyag bskor byed pa byung*/ sku 'khor rnams kyis kyang ri ba tsam mthong*/ gtor ma gnang nas gtor chog zhig kyang mdzad/ g.yung dar gling du phebs gsung chos dang bkod pa mdzad/ dbang phyug pho brang gi zhal ba'i ngos su zhabs rjes zhig byon/ snye mo zam pa mi brtan par phyag nas gnang bas de phyin chad brtan par byung*/ mtshur phur phebs/ yangs can pa mang por kha che paṇa chen gyi bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs dang*/ spyi 'dus zhi drag seng gdong tshe dbang bcas mdzad/ rdor sems bum chog mdzad pa'i bum chu lud/ de las ril bu byas pa'ang mang du 'phel/ ril nag mdzad pa'ang mang du 'phel/ rnying lugs ril sgrub gnang bar sku pang du 'phur ba'i ril bu las bdud rtsi babs/ stag lung bkra shis dpal grub khams su pheb pa'i sku brdzangs phul/ sde srid gtsong pa 'das pa'i 'das rdzongs mchod yon nas phul bar bsngo smon gnang*/

sa glang lor maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog dang sgrol mdos sogs mdzad/ yangs can mkhan por 'jigs mdzad kyi dbang mdzad/ o rod rgyal mo'i bsngo rten 'byor/ yang zur gyi grwa pa nyis brgya skor la rje dgu pa'i phyag chen khrid rgyas pa dang*/ rlung sems dbyer med kyi khrid bla sgrub phyi nang gsang gsum rnams stsal/ yangs can du karma nyi ma bskos/ bstan rim du sgrol ma dang sher snying 'bum ther/ bka' brgyad kyi gtor bzlog/ bka' 'gyur gsung sgrogs mdzad/ gzhung mchod yon du dbyen zhus 'ga' re song ba'i dag ther du lha sar phebs/ rgyal dbang lnga pa mchod yon mjal bas thugs dag par ma zad gnang cha mang po'ang thob/ rtse lha sgang gi rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i gdung la byon pa'i bcu gcig zhal de kong po zhig gis phul ba legs tshogs che/ zur rir mdo mkhar sku skye dang*/ mtshur grwa tshang bla mar lha phu sku skye bskos/ kre ho zhing brjes pa'i 'dren par ban de dgon du spyan drangs 'bul zhabs rgya cher phul/ chu 'brug lor mtshur phur phebs/ gcung 'jig rten dbang phyug gshegs par rjes sgrub rgya chen mdzad/ chu dbar sgrub sde'i mchod gzhis skor la mchod yon la zhu sbyar mdzad/ rgyal dbang lnga pa rgya nag tu phebs par/ stod lung tshal spror mjal phebs rdzongs phul/ ku ru kul+le'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mdzad pa'i thabs kyi re khā zhal ba'i ngos su thim pa lta bu'i rang byung du gsal ba de thugs rje lha khang du drangs nas phyis dngul gdung du bzhugs/ bla ma stag tshang bar phyag chen/ tshem bu slar khrid sogs gnang*/ chu sbrul lor rje lnga pa chen po rgya nag nas lha sar phebs par zhal mjal du phebs par rtse shod nas rkya thab kyi bsu ma bcas gnang*/ gong zhabs su rta nyi shu skor sogs phul/ thugs pheb pa'i gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ shing rta'i lo sar sogs mtshur phur mdzad/ rje lnga pa chen po nas sku skyos dar gos gser dngul sogs stsal ba 'byor/

rang byung ba'i mtshal zhal ma gsos sku mtshams bdun phrag gcig mdzad/ yangs can pa'i sgrub pa ba sogs bzhi bcu skor la bsnyen rdzogs gnang bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gshegs pa'i 'das rdzongs 'byor/ 'bri gung dkon mchog rin chen gshegs par mchod 'bul gyi bang mi brdzangs/ mchod 'bul rten rgya cher la ba'ang 'byor/ shing lug lor yangs can mkhan po sogs la phag mo bam̐ bskyed ma'i dbang sogs stsal/ o rod gyi rgyal brgyud mkhan po hu thog thus mjal/ phyag rdor rjes gnang stsal bas skye ba phyi ma 'khor du skye ba'i smon lam mdzad 'dug /mtshur grwa tshang gi slob dpon du sde bser rdzong ba'i lha btsun thub bstan rab 'phel dang*/ sngags cog tu karma sgrub brgyud/ kong 'phrang du karma ye shes/ mtsho dkar du tshul khrims snying po rnams bskos/ lo tsā ba sde pa bla mar sgra skor gyi dri mol mdzad/ me sprel lor grwa slob gyi sgrub pa mang pos rtogs 'bul dang*/ de la gdams ngag gnang ba sogs mdzad/ bla ma ngag dbang bkra shis la mos gus chen mo'i khrid sogs stsal to// gzhan sil bu mang po bkod par bya ste karma phrin las dbang por bye ma a krong gi slob dpon sku tshab gnang bar sku de las bdud rtsi babs brag dkar lha chur phebs skabs dus chu nyin rangs par bab pa'i chu nang nas mar me lnga shar/ rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i sku bzhengs par rab gnas mdzad skabs sku las 'od 'bar/ bla ma drung yig pa'i phyi rten du rten bzhengs mdzad pa'i sku rgyu byin rlabs gnang skabs zangs la dpal be'u pad+ma dung 'khor lo sogs rang byung du shar/ yangs can du rjes ma phebs skabs thog ser bab pa dgongs pa gtad pas zhi/ bsam yas su pheb skabs mchod rten dkar po las 'phel gdung mang po bab pa phyag tu bzhes/ stag lung pa'i rag sku bkra shis dpal 'bar gyi rigs zhig phyag tu bzhugs pa la gsol 'debs mdzad res ring bsrel mang du 'byung*/

rta phag gi sgrub pa mdzad skabs gter srung dngos su gzigs/ rdor legs kyis phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs/ sde srid karma bstan skyong dbang pos bsam rtser yab sras la 'bul chen mdzad skabs bkris pa'i dar sum 'brel nam mkhar bskyod de mdud pa gsum dang bcas pho brang gi steng du babs/ lhag pa'i lha dang mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i gzigs snang ni dus kun tu byams klas kho nar mnga'o/ /sa khyi zla ba dang po'i nyin byis pa zhig gis rje nyid rta dkar po zhig chibs nas sbrin gseb tu phebs song ba mthong*/ gzhan dag gi rmi lam du'ang rje nyid lho phyogs 'ja' 'od kyi klong du phebs song ba sogs rmis 'dug /dgung lo zhe gnyis pas khyi dbo zla'i tshes gsum la 'og min mtshur phu'i zhal ras lha khang du yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur to// sku gdung rin po che zhugs su bzhus pas dbu thod dang zhal khyim rang byon du phebs par/ rin po che sna tshogs las lha babs kyi mchod rten bzhengs pa'i snying por gdung rus bcas bzhugs te rab gnas shing mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshos mchod par byas so// ༈¿¿rje nyid kyi slob ma'i tshogs rnams ni/ dpa' bo sprul pa'i sku kun tu bzang po/ ri bo che'i chos rje grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sgam po gdung brgyud chos rje/ 'bri khung zhabs drung rin chen dpal grub/ rgod tshang sprul sku/ sprul sku bka' brgyud sgron me/ tre ho sprul sku bstan 'dzin dar rgyas/ bo dong 'chi med sprul sku/ zhabs drung ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ bon lung pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po/ dhī tsha sku skye 'jig rten dbang phyug dang dkon mchog ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ gter ston yol mo sku skye/ kha reg sku skye karma bstan srung*/ 'brug yongs 'dzin sku skye/ zangs mtsho sku skye rnams dang*/

drung yig blo gros nor ldan dang*/ bya btang bstan pa rnam rgyal/ grub dbang karma nor bu rnams kyis kyang rje dgu pa dang gnyis su med pa'i rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin pa yin no/ /rje 'di'i rnam thar 'di yang mkhan po karma nyi mas rnam thar zin bris dang*/ nyin gling rab 'byams pa karma rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rnam thar la ston sgom karma tshogs gnyis kyis kha bskang mdzad pa rnams kyi snying po bsdus pa rje stag lung ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyis mdzad pa las bsdus te bkod pa'o// ༈¿¿drung yig pa blo gros nor ldan ni/ e'i dzal chung du/ yab yon bdag chos bzang*/ yum bkra shis 'dzom zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs/ khyim na bzhugs pa'i ming sangs rgyas bkra shis/ dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes tshe/ rtse le rig 'dzin chen po'i drung nas rab tu byung bas mtshan rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin du btags/ snying thig ya bzhi'i khrid rnams zhus/ rje de yi bka' ltar rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi drung yig 'chi med mkhas pa'i drung du yi ge'i rnam grangs mang po dang*/ sgra dang snyan ngag sogs rig gnas thams cad la mkhas par skyangs rtse le sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su gter ston 'ja' tshon pa phebs pa'i slob dpon du lho la byon/ bka' brgyad kyi sgrub chen lan mang du btsugs pa'i phyag g.yog zhus zhing de'i dbang thob/ lha ris dgon du gso rig rgyud bzhi'i slob gnyer byed pa dang sde pa mdangs dkar ba'i zhal ngo rnams la slob gnyer slob kyin yod skabs/ rgyal ba'i dbang po sha 'ug tu mjal/ dad pa tshad med skyes nga yi bla ma de 'dis byed bsam pa byung*/ sgar du e sdod phebs pas/ dar kha gang gi gnang sbyin mi mdzad pa dang*/ sne mor mi bsko ba dang*/ chos gnang tshad kyi gral du 'jog pa gsum gyi mchog bslangs/ de nas bzung phyag dpe bri ba kho na'i zhabs phyi zhus/ brag dkar lha chur rje dgu pa sku mtshams gnang skabs/

rje 'dis sku mtshams kyi thog ma rang mdzad/ brag sgrub sder rgyal ba'i dbang po'i drung nas tshigs gsum rim nod kyis bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ mtshan karma blo gros nor ldan gnang*/ nyams len snying por dril rtogs pa rim pas phul/ zhal gdams gnang ba rnams zin bris su thob gsungs pa ltar zin bris su btab/ mi med lung stong zhig tu mi tshe don ldan zhig byed bsam pa las med pa dang*/ nub mo sku tshag mi lhod pa dang dbu sngas mi 'jog /rtse lha sgang du ar las tshugs par karma pa rang gis kyang sa rdo skyel ba gnang*/ gzhan sgar pa rnams kyis kyang sa rdo bskyal dgos 'dug par/ der sgar pa chas ka dkon po la rang rang gi phye bsgrub dgos par byung mod/ rje 'di kun spangs yin pas kham bu kho nas zas go bcad cing sa rdo yang khral mthong min par rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku skal sogs phul/ gzhan la skyel grogs yang byas pas ja thug ster mi yang byung gsungs skabs der rgal rma na tsha chen po byung ba'i ngo bo bskyangs pas bde chen du grol/ rnag khrag 'byams kyang grogs mched gcig ma gtogs gzhan la gsang ste las ka sngar ltar byas pa rma yang sos/ sngar dge sbyor la gegs skyon 'ga' re byung ba yang des sel nas dge sbyor la skyed chen po byung ngo*/ /de ltar sgar chen du lo drug/ de nas lo bcu bzhir yangs ri'i cog mtshams la bzhugs/ sku rab bkra shis sgang dang bshad sgrub gling du cog mtshams yun ring mdzad/ sbas nam du mun mtshams mdzad par gral gseb thams cad shig gis gang te shig sro'i char babs kyang gnod ma nus chos drug gi khrid zhus te lo gsum gyi bar du mtshan mo ras rkyang kho na mdzad/ rje karma pa'i bka' ltar de nas bzung ras bud kyi rgyun ma chad par mdzad/ mtshur phu dang chu dbar chu bo ri sogs su ras bud kyi rgyun btsugs/ de nas gar dbang drug pa'i zhabs phyir bsam yas dang thil du byon/

a phyi chos kyi sgrol mas phrin las bsgrub par khas blang*/ kyu ra phug tu lo mtshams mdzad/ sku rab bkra shis sgang du dgu 'dren skabs chu gzhung du ras bud mdzad/ chu yi bcud len yang zla gcig gnang*/ sgar du bzhugs ring yang ja ro dang rtsam pa dang chu tsam la brten/ zhwa dmar drung nas rdor phreng dang*/ phyag chen rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ chos drug /khrid thung pusti/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i drung nas mi tra brgya rtsa/ phag mo lha khrid/ si tu'i drung nas tshe dpag lha dgu dang phag mo lha lnga gtum chung*/ rje dgu pa'i drung nas lhan cig skyes sbyor dang nā ro chos drug gi khrid dang*/ rgyal tshab rin po che nas/ phyag chen dang*/ rdo rje zam pa/ ngal gso skor gsum/ lam sgron sogs dang*/ rje dgu pa nas rgyud skor dang*/ rgyal tshab nas mdo mang sogs bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs kyi lung zhus/ yang rir bzhugs skabs kun gyis bla mar bkur nas drung pa shag rog pa ma mnyes/ 'jang rgyal pos chos sde gsar 'dzugs bla mar gdan 'dren pa'i zhu yig 'byor bar drung pa shag rog pas 'di pa mngags thabs zhus par/ rje 'di yi thugs 'dod ltar bla mar phebs pa dang sgar 'bud pa'i 'dem ga phebs pas dra phad rgyab du bsnams te sgar nas 'bud pa rang 'dam par mdzad/ dbu ri'i dus mkhyen sbug tu bzhugs/ bde drod rang 'bar du song*/ g.ya' tshan kho na gsol/ /nub gcig sang nub lha 'dre'i dmag yong rgyu yin zer ba byung yang*/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas ci yang ma byung*/ rje dpon a skyabs kyis zhus te khyung rdzong du mun mtshams la lo bzhir bzhugs/ gnas bdag gis phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs/ mtshur nang kun ras drod kyis dros pa byung*/ nyin mtshan dang mnyam rjes bral/ nyams skyong ba'i phyir lha ldan du phebs jo bo'i lcags khra mdun du lo gsum bzhugs/ gangs dkar ba'i slob dpon zhig rje 'di 'dul du byung ba la bde mchog gi chos skad gsungs pas gus pas btud/
chos klog pa rnams kyis rgol ba pa rnams kyang dad par mdzad/ 'phrul snang du lo phyed lngar bzhugs pas dkor gnyer ba kun shin tu dad/ sog po sogs kyi rta 'bul byed pa mang du byung yang ma bzhes/

de nas yer pa tshal gung thang*/ dur khrod blo mos rgyas/ gsang ne'u thog sogs su bzhugs/ dge bshes gzi brjid pas mjal/ mtshur phur rje bcu pa phebs par/ drung pa shag rog pas mjal kha bkag dogs nas shar mar sku mdun du song bas dgyes dgyes dpe med gnang*/ dbur rir dus mkhyen phug tu zwa kho na bzhes te bzhugs skabs mi zhig gis mdzar zan phul bas phan chen po byung gsungs/ rdo ba chen po 'gril byung bar zhabs g.yon pa'i rjes byon/ tsā rir dpal lha mos bskul te mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral du byon pa sogs dang lhag pa'i lha yi gzigs snang sogs mtha' yas/ rje gar gyi dbang pos bkas gnang te legs bshad gling gi chos rje karma thub bstan dang karma chags med sogs la phyag chen dang chos drug gi khrid gnang*/ khrom sar sgar chen mjal du phebs pas dwags khyi mang po 'dug pas 'dris 'dris byas pa de rnams ngo mtshar/ sgar chen gyi drung skor rnams dang dga' tshal ba'i dge 'dun rnams sogs skya ser mang por chos khrid gnang*/ dwags po drung 'tsho bas thog mar mjal/ tshe chu 'bum par phebs pas 'bum pa'i phyogs thams cad nas bdud rtsi babs/ 'di skabs drung pa shag rog pa sgar nas phyes/ yab sras lhan rgyas kyi legs tshogs shar/ de nas dwags po drung 'tsho ba dang gnyis yar lung gnas gsum/ shel brag /gzhung sprel rnams su phebs/ der mi la'i sgrub phug sgo rang byed byung bas thams cad ngo mtshar/ mtshur phur chos khrims pa kun dga' don 'grub sogs mang por phyag chen sogs kyi khrid mdzad/ chu bo ri'i rtse mo ba rnams dang tshe chu sgrub sde ba rnams kyis zhus nas grub chu 'ga' re bton/ nye gnas chos mdzad dpal bzang gis brag skam po zhig la 'dir chu yong ba 'dra zhus pas/ rje 'dis tog tse bsnun pas chu chen po zhig babs/ dung dkar ras chen dad de khong pa'i slob ma 'brug phyogs kyi rtogs ldan mang po chos zhur rdzong bar mdzad/

yang mtshur phur phebs grwa tshang ri gling kun la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ skya ser stong phrag tsam la phyag chen dang*/ nyis brgya tsam la chos drug gnang*/ lar 'bul ba mi bzhes kyang de skabs 'bul ba kun bzhes te mar me dang khrid zhu ba rnams la chos rgyags su gnang*/ chos zhu rnams la ye shes pa babs pa mang po byung*/ shākya rin chen bya ba nyin zhag bdun du nyams 'bar/ de nas sgar chen mjal du sras mkhar du phebs/ dus rgyun du chos gos rnam gsum dang 'bral med mdzad pa yin yang de nyin rnal 'byor pa'i chas mdzad pas rje nyid shin tu mnyes par gyur/ sgam po sprul sku/ sde pa seng rdzong pa/ rnam gling pa sogs mang por chos khrid gnang*/ gtsang du rje grags pa mchog dbyangs dang mjal/ thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ tsher lung drung pa dang chos kyi zhu gnang du ma mdzad pas/ drung pas nga skye ba phyi mar 'di 'dra zhig byed dgos gsungs/ der bzhugs sgar khag gsum gyi drung 'khor dang khams pa mang por rang rang gang 'dod kyi bka' chos rnams gnang*/ rgyal rtse bdag mo gdon gyis brlam pa la der pheb tsam gyis grol/ 'brug pa skyid phug par 'pho lung sogs gnang*/ lo der sgar chen du ras pa brgya skor thon/ 'bri khung karma brtson 'grus sogs la phyag chen khrid btab pas/ 'bri khung rin po cher thugs dman 'phar/ sde pa shel ma ba sogs re thub pa mang po byung*/ gsung rab gling pa/ dkar po brag /'gro don gling pa rnams la phyag chen gnang*/ jo mo gangs dang gra ma gru bzhir phebs/ der gnas sgrub pa ba rnams la chos 'brel gnang*/ mtshur phur phebs/ kyu ra rin po che sogs la chos drug gnang*/ zhwa dmar nas dgongs gcig dang blo sbyong gi khrid dang*/ si tu rin po che nas chos drug gi khrid stsal ba'i khrid gnyer mdzad/ lo der sgar du kyu ra rin po che gtsos ras pa nyis brgya tsam thon/ rje 'di bzo rig la mkhas pas/

shing glang lor zhwa dmar pa'i bkas 'og min gling gi gser thog zhal bkod mdzad/ mkha' spyod rdzong du bcad rgyar bzhugs/ gsung sprul dang mjal/ thob rgyal dpon sas gdan drangs/ dpon sa dang 'dul grwa khri brtan sngags grwa rnams kyi dge 'dun rnams la chos 'brel gnang mchims phur phebs/ sgrub pa ba rnams la chos 'brel gnang*/ mtshur phur ras chos gnang bas ras pa brgya lhag thon/ kha ba chen po bab nas ku lag rnams kha ba'i zhabs su non pas des rkyen byas snying rje chen po skyes zhing*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar zhwa dmar pa zhal gzigs nas rje 'di'i bstan pa la bya ba byed do snyam pa 'khrungs/ dar phyung dang tshal min du phebs/ khye'u lnga bcu tsam gyi skra phud bzhes/ dbyar gnas spang shang ha rir mdzad/ dar phyur nas zhal ngo rnams dang*/ sngags grwa ha ri rnams kyi grwa pa rnams la phyag chen gnang*/ 'bri khung du phebs zhabs drung ngag dbang rin chen sogs la chos 'brel mdzad/ de nas rje gar gyi dbang po'i bkas slob phrug brgya dang bcas te chu dbar du sgrub sde 'dzugs par phebs/ dbu ri'i mdun du bzhugs nub tshe ring mched lnga bsu mar byon/ blon po dgon gyi zhabs drung sku mched nas spyan drangs te chos 'brel zhus/ chu dbar du phebs karma legs grub sogs 'dus sder/ phyag chen chos drug ro snyom sgang dril blo sbyong gcod khrid mos gus chen mo'i khrid sogs gnang*/ dge 'dun rnams la mang 'gyed/ gos sbyin mang po phul/ lo der dge 'dun phyed dang nyis brgya tsam 'dus/ phyogs 'dus kyi tshogs pa rnams chu dbar gnas mthil du ma shong nas/ sman lung dang mchong lung sogs gnas phran thams cad sgrub sdes gang bar gyur/ ras pa chen po'i sbur rdo la yig drug rang byon yod pa phyag gis bzhes pas bdud rtsi babs pas thams cad dad pa lhag tu 'phel/ sa sbrul lor rje yab sras chu dbar du phebs pas sgrub sde tshugs pa la thugs shin tu dgyes/

rje bcu pa ti ser phebs pa'i zhabs phyir byon/ rtsam pa rkyal chung gnyis dang sha khog gsum la tshogs rdzas mdzad pas sgar pa sogs mi mda' stong phrag brgal bar sha dang zan snyims pa tsam re bkyes steng sha zan mang po lhag pa rnams 'tsho bas phong pa rnams la byin te phyogs kyi sgrub pa ba sogs rnams la chos 'brel gnang*/ chu dbar ngu ras chos pa bdun cu skor thon/ mdor na rje 'di phyi ltar du 'dul ba'i bca' khrims la gnas shing ri khrod pa rnams kyang zla phyed kyi gso sbyong sogs mdzad pa dang*/ chos drug gi nyams bzhes la rang dbang thob kyang ras rkyang sogs mtshan mo nang shin tu dben pa lta bur gsang spyod ma gtogs mi gnang ba sogs rab byung gi spyod pa 'di kho nas kyang thub bstan mdzes par mdzad pa zhig go/ zhal slob kyang kyu ra rin po che karma brtson 'grus/ sgam po pa karma legs bshad rgya mtsho/ grub dbang karma chags med/ legs bshad gling gi chos rje karma thub bstan/ 'og min gling gi chos rje karma lhun grub/ sngags grwa'i cha dkar rab 'byams pa/ chu dbar gdan sa pa karma legs grub sogs dang*/ shel brag chos rje/ dwags po drung yig pa sogs mkhas grub kyi skyes bu du ma byung zhing*/ grags pa che chung tsam las rje mi la ras chen dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa grub thob dang sgrub tshugs bsaḍa sbyangs rtogs pa rnams mnyam par dran to//
